title: ML/AI Engineer
description:
• Remote in LATAM
  • 12-month contract with potential extensions


Job Description:

We are seeking a Machine Learning Engineer to join a growing AI and data engineering team focused on building production‑ready AI products. This role sits at the intersection of data/ML pipelines, MLOps, and applied generative AI, supporting initiatives such as forecasting, inventory intelligence, and conversational/agentic AI solutions. The ideal candidate is hands‑on, comfortable moving from prototype to production, and excited about building scalable ML/AI systems. Key Responsibilities Design, build, and maintain data and machine learning pipelines to support AI‑driven products and analytics. Develop and productionize LLM‑based solutions, including conversational and agentic AI use cases. Implement MLOps best practices, including CI/CD, model lifecycle management, and deployment workflows. Collaborate on AI prototyping efforts, rapidly validating ideas and transitioning successful prototypes into production systems. Work with orchestration frameworks such as LangChain and LangGraph to support AI workflows and automation. Support initiatives related to forecasting and inventory intelligence, including contributions to a unified UI that explains what forecasts are and why they are generated. Partner closely with data engineering, data science, and business stakeholders to deliver scalable, business‑facing AI solutions. Contribute to cloud‑based architectures, with exposure to Azure (primary) and GCP (emerging footprint) as part of an upcoming cloud migration.



Required Skills:

- 5+ years of experience in ML Engineering

- Strong experience with Python for data and machine learning development.

- Advanced SQL skills for data analysis and pipeline development.

- Hands‑on experience building data/ML pipelines (minimum baseline expectation).

- Solid understanding of MLOps, including CI/CD practices for ML systems.

- Experience working with LLMs and modern AI tooling (e.g., ChatGPT, OpenAI APIs).

- Familiarity with LangChain and LangGraph for orchestration of AI workflows.

- Experience working in cloud environments, primarily Azure, with some exposure or interest in GCP


Compensation: $20-24/hour Exact compensation may vary based on several factors, including skills, experience, and education.

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


*O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


*O que você precisa ter

• Formação concluída preferencialmente na área de TI;

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office.

title: L3 Support Services Appendix REDHAT
description:
L3 Support Services Appendix REDHAT

Type: Contract

Location: Columbia/ Argentina/ Brazil (We are only considering candidates from the following countries)

Rate: DOE


Job Summary:

Objective:

Responsible for the performance, availability, and reliability of our cloud-based services and underlying infrastructure, acting as a critical technical subject matter expert.

Key Details:

• Skills: Linux (mandatory) with experience in Kubernetes, OpenShift, and OpenStack

• Experience: 7–10 years

• Interview Process: 2 rounds

• Requirements: Immediate

• Candidate has to work in CST OR EST time


Key Responsibilities:

● Manage, troubleshoot, and optimize containerized applications and infrastructure deployed on Kubernetes, Red Hat OpenShift, and OpenStack platforms.

● Serve as the Subject Matter Expert (SME) for core cloud infrastructure technologies, including advanced Linux (CentOS) system administration, Docker/Containers, and complex networking configurations.

● Lead the investigation and resolution of complex, high-severity customer issues, applying strong analytical knowledge to quickly diagnose problems across the entire cloud stack.

● Utilize your expertise to quickly identify root causes and implement effective, durable solutions for customer incidents.

● Prepare and conduct rigorous Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for critical incidents to identify systemic issues and prevent recurrence.

● Develop, test, and maintain robust automation scripts using Python and Ansible to streamline daily operational tasks and improve overall service efficiency.

● Identify and implement automation opportunities to reduce manual effort in maintenance and deployment activities.

● Provide end-to-end Escalation, Monitoring, and Emergency (EME) support, acting as a final escalation point to ensure service availability and meet SLAs.

● Liaise directly with the customer team and internal teams to understand requirements and deliver tailored technical solutions.

● Stay current with industry best practices and emerging technologies in cloud and containerization.

Scheduling:

● Our team operates on a follow-the-sun model, ensuring 24/7 coverage and rapid response times. While this may occasionally require shifts outside typical local business hours, the total work hours will remain consistent with a standard work week.

● A rotational on-call schedule is a mandatory part of this position. On-call experts are responsible for providing immediate support for urgent cases, including direct customer contact (via call/Teams) and prompt engagement in designated war rooms for case investigation and resolution.

● All interventions are performed in live environments and must strictly follow the Standard Network Touch Policy, requiring full awareness and compliance during urgent case resolution.

Required Skills & Qualifications:


● Linux Expertise: Strong knowledge and proven hands-on experience with Linux administration.

● Networking Foundations: Strong knowledge of core networking principles (TCP/IP, routing, load balancing, firewalls) in a cloud environment.

● Containerization & Virtualization: Strong knowledge of Kubernetes orchestration, OpenStack platforms, and Docker/Containerization.

● Problem-Solving Mindset: Possess sharp troubleshooting skills combined with an analytical mindset to dissect and address complex challenges.

● Scripting and Automation: Solid Python scripting skills for task automation and system management.

● Configuration Management: Hands-on experience with Ansible for configuration management.’

● Root Cause Analysis (RCA): Expertise in preparation and implementation of RCAs.

● Escalation and Monitoring: Proven experience with EME (Escalation, Monitoring, and Emergency) management processes.

Preferred Qualifications:

One or more certifications from the list below will be considered an added advantage:

Red Hat Certified Specialist in Cloud Infrastructure (EX210), Red Hat Certified Engineer (RHCE) in Red Hat OpenStack (EX310), RHCSA, RHCE, CKA, EX280 (Red Hat Certified Specialist in OpenShift Administration), EX380 (Red Hat Certified Specialist in OpenShift Automation and API Management).

Communication & Attitude:


● Excellent communication skills (written and verbal) and the ability to articulate complex issues clearly.

● Demonstrated ability to handle customer pressure and manage expectations with a positive, professional attitude.

● Strong team player, self-motivated, and capable of excelling in a high-pressure, dynamic support environment.

title: Senior .NET and AI Engineer
description:
Senior .NET and AI Engineer

(Azure and Blazor, AI-First Environment)


About the Company:

Our client is a leading pediatric healthcare organization with a long-standing history of providing comprehensive care for infants, children, and adolescents. With a strong presence across multiple states in the U.S. and international operations, the organization serves generations of families through a wide network of clinics and healthcare professionals. Backed by a team of over 2,500 employees, they continue to expand and offer a dynamic, growth-oriented environment for professionals across medical, operational, and administrative functions.


About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Engineer with strong .NET expertise and hands-on AI experience. In this role, you will build and deliver cloud-native applications while actively using AI tools and integrating AI capabilities into products.


This is not a junior position. We are looking for engineers who take ownership, think critically, and deliver real impact.


What You Will Do

  • Develop scalable applications using .NET, ASP.NET Core and Blazor
  • Build cloud-based solutions on Azure
  • Design and optimize APIs and database structures
  • Use AI tools to improve development speed and quality
  • Build and integrate AI-powered features into products


What We Are Looking For

  • 4+ years of professional C# / .NET development experience
  • Strong ASP.NET Core fundamentals — Web API, middleware, dependency injection, minimal APIs
  • Blazor experience (WebAssembly and/or Server) — production experience preferred
  • Azure services: App Service, Static Web Apps, Azure Functions, Service Bus, or similar
  • Entity Framework Core — schema design, migrations, query optimization, and knowing when NOT to use the ORM
  • SQL proficiency: query writing, indexing, and diagnosing performance issues
  • Solid REST API design and consumption patterns
  • Git-based workflows: branching strategies, PR culture, code review


Testing (Emphasized)

  • Strong experience with unit, integration and end-to-end testing
  • Hands-on experience with tools such as xUnit or NUnit and mocking libraries
  • Experience with integration testing approaches such as TestServer or similar
  • Familiarity with end-to-end testing tools such as Playwright is a plus
  • Ability to design meaningful test scenarios and prioritize quality over coverage metrics


AI-Assisted Development

  • Active use of AI coding tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor or similar in daily work
  • Strong prompt writing skills and ability to guide AI effectively
  • Experience using AI for code generation, refactoring, documentation and code review
  • Ability to critically evaluate AI-generated outputs and ensure code quality
  • Keeping up to date with evolving AI tools and applying them in development workflows


Building AI-Powered Features

  • Experience integrating LLM APIs into applications
  • Understanding of AI-driven workflows and agent-based systems
  • Familiarity with concepts such as RAG, semantic search or vector databases
  • Ability to evaluate AI outputs and design reliable user-facing features
  • Awareness of data privacy and security considerations when working with AI


Nice to Have

  • Azure AI services and monitoring tools
  • CI/CD pipeline experience
  • Experience in healthcare or regulated environments


Who You Are

  • You write clean and maintainable code
  • You take ownership and deliver end-to-end
  • You focus on building rather than discussing
  • You are curious, proactive and open to continuous learning


If you enjoy building real products and working with modern technologies, we would be happy to hear from you.

title: Immigration Attorney (US-licensed)
description:
About the job

POSITION SPECIFICATION

Position Title: Immigration Attorney (US license is required)

Reporting To: Chief Supervising Attorney

Location: Hybrid (Preferred location: Brazil)

The Company: HAYMAN-WOODWARD GMS


ABOUT US

HAYMAN-WOODWARD GMS is a globally recognized immigration and advisory firm. Based in Dubai, UAE, with offices across 9 countries, we specialize in facilitating seamless global transitions for individuals and businesses. Our expertise in U.S. employment-based immigration law positions us uniquely to navigate complex immigration procedures, enabling our clients to flourish in their chosen international markets.

POSITION SUMMARY

As an Immigration Attorney, you will be instrumental in guiding clients through the multifaceted immigration process. Your role demands a comprehensive understanding of immigration law and exceptional client service skills, ensuring successful outcomes in various legal scenarios. Your responsibilities include:

  • Client Consultation and Advocacy : Providing personalized legal consultation, understanding each client’s unique needs, and advising on the most viable legal options. Your role involves zealous representation of clients' interests, maintaining transparent communication, and filing G-28s on their behalf. Representation includes evaluation of complex eligibility and admissibility issues, RFE/NOID prevention strategy, participation in legal strategy meetings.
  • Case Management and Strategy Development: Leading a diverse range of immigration cases from inception to resolution. This includes strategizing tailored solutions, analyzing case specifics, and foreseeing potential challenges to address them proactively.
  • Preparation and Submission of Cases: Crafting compelling petitions for various immigration applications such as work visas, family-based petitions, adjustment of status, and naturalization. Your meticulous attention to detail is crucial in ensuring accuracy and compliance with current immigration laws. This also involves staying abreast of legal developments and preparing detailed legal briefs and reports.
  • Collaboration and Team Leadership: Working in tandem with paralegals, legal assistants, and other attorneys. You will mentor and oversee junior staff to ensure high-quality, timely casework.
  • Response to Legal Queries: Addressing Requests for Additional Evidence (RFEs), Notices of Intent to Deny (NOIDs), and Notices of Intent to Revoke (NOIRs) from government agencies through detailed analysis and preparation of persuasive responses.
  • Appeals and Legal Motions: Managing appeals and motions to reconsider or reopen cases, crafting comprehensive legal arguments to uphold client positions.

EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS AND EDUCATIONAL BACKGROUND

  • J.D. from an ABA-approved law school.
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in employment-based immigration law.
  • An active member in good standing with a state Bar, with eligibility to represent clients and sign G-28s.
  • Proficiency in EB1, EB2-NIW, O1, PERM labor certifications, H-1B, L-1, and E visa matters.
  • Fluency in a second language is desirable.
  • Supervisory Responsibility: Yes, including oversight of cases and potential supervision of paralegals and case managers.


KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS

  • Adept at persuasive legal writing and advocacy.
  • Detail-oriented with strong organizational skills.
  • Excellent communication, customer service, and writing abilities.
  • Ability to work independently or collaboratively within a team.

APPLICATION PROCEDURES

  • Start Date: Immediate.
  • Work Schedule: Monday to Friday, 9:30 AM - 6:30 PM.
  • Location: Remote.
  • Compensation & Benifits:

-Competitive salary

-Home office allowance

-Health insurance (after probation period)

-Dental plan

-CLT employment contract with full statutory benefits

  • Current clients or family members of employees are not eligible.
  • Email your resume and cover letter in PDF format to , referencing \"Immigration Attorney position”.

CX Travel Specialist (Early Morning Shift - From 4 AM to 13 PM Brazil time)

• Manage bookings for flights, hotels, and car rentals via Amadeus and other tools.

• Handle client requests, changes, and special services via WhatsApp and email.

• Process exchanges, refunds, EMDs, and monitor itineraries proactively.

• Support VIP and C-level travelers with high-touch, discreet service.

• Collaborate with internal teams to ensure accuracy and client satisfaction.

description:
Disruptive Talents, a boutique headhunting and strategic recruitment firm, is collaborating with an international Forex brokerage to identify a Business Development Manager (BDM) – Brazil.


At Disruptive Talents, we connect commercially driven talent with high-growth financial services organizations. This search is conducted on behalf of an international Forex brokerage seeking to accelerate client acquisition, strategic partnerships, and revenue growth across the Brazilian and Latin American markets.


This is a strategic opportunity to join the commercial growth team at a critical stage of the company’s expansion in Brazil, playing a central role in developing client relationships, strategic partnerships, and long-term revenue growth in the local market.


About the Company


A regulated international Forex brokerage operating across multiple jurisdictions, the company provides trading access and infrastructure solutions to professional traders, institutional clients, introducing brokers (IBs), asset managers, and strategic partners. With a growing global footprint and a strong emphasis on technology, compliance, and scalable brokerage solutions, the firm continues to expand its presence in key regional markets, including Colombia, Mexico and Brazil.


As a Business Development Manager, you will focus on expanding the company’s footprint among professional traders, institutional clients, introducing brokers (IBs), asset managers, and strategic partners.

The ideal candidate brings a strong understanding of financial markets, brokerage products, and client trading needs, paired with a consultative, relationship-led sales approach.


What You Will Do:


Business Growth & Revenue

  • Identify, develop, and close new business opportunities across FX, CFDs, equities, derivatives, or multi-asset trading solutions.
  • Drive revenue growth through direct client acquisition and strategic partnerships (IBs, affiliates, money managers).
  • Own the full sales cycle: prospecting, pitching, negotiation, onboarding coordination, and account growth.
  • Achieve and exceed individual and team revenue targets.


Client & Partner Management

  • Build long-term relationships with professional traders, institutional clients, and high-value partners.
  • Act as a trusted commercial advisor, aligning client trading needs with platform capabilities, pricing, and liquidity solutions.
  • Support retention and account expansion by identifying cross-sell and upsell opportunities.


Market & Industry Intelligence

  • Stay current on global financial market trends, trading technologies, and competitor offerings.
  • Monitor regulatory developments (e.g., MiFID II, FCA, CySEC, ASIC) and ensure commercial activity aligns with compliance requirements.
  • Represent the company at industry events, conferences, and client meetings.


Internal Collaboration

  • Work closely with trading, liquidity, risk, compliance, and operations teams to ensure seamless client onboarding and service delivery.
  • Partner with marketing to support lead-generation campaigns and regional growth initiatives.
  • Maintain accurate pipeline management, forecasts, and performance reporting via CRM tools.


What We Are Looking For:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business, or a related field.
  • 3–7+ years of business development, sales, or relationship management experience within financial markets brokerage (FX, CFDs, equities, crypto, or derivatives).
  • Strong understanding of trading platforms, brokerage revenue models, and client acquisition channels.
  • Proven track record of meeting or exceeding revenue targets.
  • Deep interest in financial markets and trading products.
  • Strong negotiation and closing skills.
  • Relationship-driven, consultative sales mindset.
  • Excellent communication and presentation abilities.
  • Highly organized, data-driven, and comfortable working with CRM and reporting tools.


What We Offer:

  • Competitive base salary plus performance-based commission.
  • Exposure to global financial markets and high-value clients.
  • Clear career progression in a fast-growing brokerage environment.
  • Collaborative, performance-oriented culture.


How to Apply:

  • If you thrive in fast-moving financial markets and enjoy building profitable, long-term client relationships, we’d love to hear from you

title: Especialista CX - Afirmativa PCD
description:
Nossa área de Customer Experience (CX) é uma das principais alavancas de retenção e eficiência do grupo. Como Especialista de CX e Qualidade operacional, você trabalhará com equipes multifuncionais para identificar gargalos que impactam a experiência do cliente e a performance do negócio. Você será o guardião dos Fóruns de Qualidade, liderando os esforços desde o diagnóstico de indicadores até a implementação de novos fluxos de trabalho.


É uma função de ritmo acelerado e alta visibilidade, onde o foco é a resolução de problemas complexos. O Especialista lidera a conexão entre os silos da organização, a consolidação de processos de atendimento e a transferência de boas práticas entre os times para garantir que o cliente alcance o sucesso no menor tempo possível.


Responsabilidades e Atribuições:

  • Liderar os Fóruns de CX e Operações: Garantir o ótimo relacionamento com os líderes de Comercial, Suporte e Implantação, alinhando metas, processos e comunicação.
  • Gestão de Indicadores: Analisar e reportar o progresso de métricas críticas (TTV, CSAT, Throughput, Tempo de Resposta) em relação aos objetivos de negócio.
  • Mapeamento de Jornada: Desenhar processos e modelos de atendimento, identificando proativamente oportunidades de otimização e redução de atrito para o cliente.
  • Gestão de Projetos de Melhoria: Desenvolver e acompanhar planos de ação pós-diagnóstico, garantindo que as melhorias discutidas sejam implementadas e gerem o valor esperado.
  • Mitigação de Riscos: Identificar gargalos operacionais que possam gerar churn ou queda de satisfação e ajustar os planos de execução conforme necessário.
  • Voz do Cliente: Assegurar a disseminação de feedbacks qualitativos para toda a organização, influenciando a evolução do produto e do serviço.
  • Report Estratégico: Comunicar o progresso das iniciativas de CX e os ganhos de eficiência para os stakeholders e lideranças.


Requisitos e Qualificações:

  • 5+ anos de experiência em Customer Experience, CX Ops ou Gestão de Projetos Operacionais.
  • Experiência em mapeamento de processos e desenho de jornadas de cliente.
  • Comunicação verbal e escrita clara, objetiva e com foco em dados.
  • Capacidade de engajar e liderar pessoas e áreas, independente de subordinação hierárquica (influência lateral).
  • Perfil analítico e executor: Conforto em navegar entre dashboards e a implementação prática de processos.

Content & Provider Curation

  • Organize providers by modality, topic, availability, and seasonality

  • Select providers and content to feature based on campaigns and priorities

Cross-Channel Content Management

  • Plan and coordinate content across:
  • Email marketing
  • Blog
  • LinkedIn
  • Social media
  • Podcast promotions
  • Build weekly and monthly content plans aligning providers, topics, and channels
  • Ensure content is accurate, current, and aligned across all surfaces

Podcast & Media Coordination

  • Social scheduling support
  • Podcast and blog publishing
  • Manage handoffs between team members to ensure timely publication

Lead Awareness & Performance Tracking

  • Monitor inbound interest generated from content
  • Flag provider-related leads and opportunities for follow-up
  • Track engagement and performance across channels
  • Identify patterns in what drives clicks, inquiries, and bookings


Who You Are

  • Highly organized and detail-oriented
  • Comfortable managing content across multiple channels at scale
  • Strong written English (professional working proficiency)
  • Process-driven and systems-oriented
  • Able to prioritize independently and manage recurring workflows
  • Clear communicator who keeps work moving across teams


Qualifications

title: Product Manager Sênior - Planejamento Comercial
description:
Sobre a posição no jogo

Estamos em busca de uma pessoa Product Manager Sênior para liderar a evolução das soluções de Planejamento Comercial , atuando na interseção entre negócio, dados e tecnologia.

Essa posição tem como missão maximizar a rentabilidade e a eficiência do portfólio de produtos, conectando o ciclo de vida do produto (PLM) à inteligência de mercado e ao planejamento de compras , garantindo decisões orientadas por dados, menor time-to-market e melhor alocação de capital em estoque.

Você será responsável por transformar dores do time comercial (Buying & Planning) em produtos digitais escaláveis, garantindo adoção real, automação e impacto direto em KPIs críticos do negócio.


Missão da Área

Maximizar a rentabilidade e a eficiência do portfólio de produtos através da tecnologia, integrando o ciclo de vida do produto (PLM) à inteligência de mercado, para suportar decisões de compra e sortimento orientadas por dados, com maior agilidade e menor risco.


Objetivos estratégicos do produto

  • Digitalização do ciclo de vida do Produto;
  • Implementar e evoluir a plataforma de PLM, centralizando o desenvolvimento desde o conceito até a ficha técnica final;
  • Inteligência de Compra e Planejamento;
  • Criar ou integrar soluções que automatizem o cálculo de OTB (Open to Buy) e recomendem sortimento ideal por canal, região e perfil de demanda.
  • Conexão com o Mercado;
  • Traduzir tendências, dados de concorrência e sinais de mercado em parâmetros técnicos para o desenvolvimento e planejamento de novos produtos;
  • Eficiência Operacional;
  • Reduzir rupturas, excessos de estoque e markdowns por meio de previsões de demanda, planejamento integrado e automação de processos.


Responsabilidades

  • Definir e liderar a visão e estratégia do produto de Planejamento Comercial , alinhando tecnologia às necessidades do negócio;
  • Gerenciar a evolução contínua das ferramentas de PLM e Planning , garantindo estabilidade, escalabilidade e adoção;
  • Atuar como braço tecnológico do time comercial , conduzindo discovery com compradores, planejadores e áreas correlatas;
  • Traduzir dores de negócio em soluções digitais, processos otimizados e integrações sistêmicas ;
  • Garantir a arquitetura e integridade dos dados de produto , do nascimento no PLM até a venda no PDV e e-commerce;
  • Avaliar e conduzir decisões de Build vs. Buy , considerando custo, tempo, escalabilidade e aderência ao negócio;
  • Priorizar roadmap e backlog com base em impacto em rentabilidade, eficiência operacional e risco de estoque ;
  • Trabalhar em parceria com Engenharia, Dados, SAP e fornecedores externos;
  • Garantir que o plano de compras aprovado seja convertido em pedidos automatizados (PO) no SAP , com mínima intervenção manual;
  • Monitorar e comunicar resultados por meio de KPIs claros e orientados a impacto .


Escopo Tecnológico

Você atuará diretamente na evolução e integração dos seguintes pilares:

  • PLM (Product Lifecycle Management)
  • Desenvolvimento de produtos, fornecedores, custos, ciclo de vida e cadastros.
  • Demand Planning & Analytics
  • Modelagem de dados e algoritmos para suporte ao planejamento de compras.
  • Market Intelligence Hub
  • Integração de APIs e dados externos de mercado e concorrência.
  • ERP (SAP – MM / Retail)
  • Integração robusta para automação do ciclo de compra, pedidos e cadastros.
  • Automação do Planejamento para Pedido
  • Conversão de planejamento em Pedidos de Compra (PO) automáticos
  • Sincronização de mestres (materiais e fornecedores)
  • Monitoramento de status de recebimento e notas fiscais


Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Experiência sólida como Product Manager Sênior em contextos de varejo, indústria ou operações comerciais complexas ;
  • Conhecimento profundo do ciclo de vida do produto (PLM, Buying, Planning, Supply) ;
  • Experiência atuando com sistemas corporativos e integrações (ex.: ERP, PLM, Planning);
  • Forte capacidade analítica, com uso de dados para tomada de decisão ;
  • Vivência em discovery com áreas não-digitais (ex.: Comercial, Compras, Planejamento);
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis ;
  • Comunicação clara, estruturada e habilidade em negociação de prioridades com múltiplos stakeholders .


Diferenciais Desejáveis

  • Experiência prévia com SAP MM ou SAP Retail ;
  • Conhecimento em OTB (Open to Buy) , planejamento de sortimento e previsão de demanda;
  • Domínio de SQL, Power BI ou ferramentas analíticas similares ;
  • Experiência em decisões de Build vs. Buy e gestão de fornecedores de software;
  • Atuação em ambientes de transformação digital de áreas comerciais .


O que define sucesso nessa posição

  • Redução do lead time do ciclo de desenvolvimento de produtos (briefing → venda);
  • Alta taxa de adoção das ferramentas pelo time de Compras e Planejamento;
  • Crescimento do percentual de pedidos automatizados (Zero-Touch PO) ;
  • Melhor aderência ao OTB planejado ;
  • Redução de markdowns e maior venda a preço cheio.


Por que essa vaga é especial?

Porque você vai liderar um produto que atua no coração da decisão comercial da empresa , conectando estratégia, dados e execução.

Aqui, decisões de produto impactam diretamente margem, capital investido em estoque e velocidade de reação ao mercado . É uma posição para quem gosta de complexidade real , influência transversal e impacto mensurável no resultado do negócio.

Bora movimentar o esporte.

title: Especialista em Chatbot & Conversão — Curadoria, Otimização e Escala (WhatsApp e IA)
description:
Vaga para modelo de contratação PJ


Remoto


A ConCrédito é uma das maiores correspondentes bancárias do Brasil, especializada em crédito consignado nas modalidades CLT, INSS e FGTS. Com mais de 300 mil clientes atendidos via WhatsApp, a ConCrédito preza pelo bom atendimento e pela experiência do cliente, comprovados pelas mais de 21 mil avaliações positivas no Google Meu Negócio.


O Papel

O Especialista em Chatbot & Conversão será responsável por evoluir a jornada conversacional da empresa no WhatsApp, nosso principal canal de aquisição e conversão. Essa pessoa atuará na otimização contínua da experiência, reduzindo atritos, recuperando leads e aumentando a eficiência do funil por meio de automação, testes e uso de IA.



Responsabilidades

  • Mapear, analisar e otimizar a jornada conversacional de ponta a ponta no WhatsApp, identificando gargalos, fricções e oportunidades de melhoria nas micro e macroconversões.
  • Evoluir a arquitetura dos fluxos conversacionais com foco em experiência, engajamento, recuperação e conversão.
  • Rodar testes A/B contínuos em mensagens, copywriting, timing de follow-ups, segmentações e estrutura de fluxo.
  • Criar e gerir réguas de relacionamento, ativação de leads frios, campanhas de reengajamento e estratégias de recuperação.
  • Trabalhar na personalização da jornada a partir de clusters de audiência, comportamento e contexto do cliente.
  • Apoiar a construção de dashboards e análises da jornada em parceria com o time de Dados, garantindo visibilidade dos principais indicadores de performance.
  • Atuar de forma cross-functional com Marketing, Vendas, BI, Operações e Produto/Tech para transformar insights em melhorias concretas na experiência e nos resultados.
  • Contribuir com o uso de IA e automação para escalar conversas com mais eficiência, relevância e capacidade de conversão.


KPIs sob sua gestão

  • Ativação: taxa de ativação de leads recém-chegados ao chatbot.
  • Conversão do funil: eficiência na passagem entre etapas do fluxo conversacional.
  • Taxa de abandono: redução de drop-off em cada estágio da jornada.
  • Time-to-convert: redução do tempo médio para contratação efetiva.
  • Retenção e recompra: aumento do LTV e da frequência de uso dos serviços.
  • ROI de campanhas: retorno sobre campanhas de repescagem e disparos via WhatsApp.


Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Experiência sólida em Growth, CRO, Lifecycle, CRM, Produto ou áreas correlatas, com foco em conversão e evolução de jornada.
  • Vivência prática com canais conversacionais, especialmente WhatsApp, automação de mensagens e/ou chatbots.
  • Capacidade de mapear funis, identificar gargalos e transformar análise em ação.
  • Repertório em testes A/B, experimentação e otimização contínua de jornada.
  • Capacidade analítica avançada para acompanhar métricas de funil, cohort, LTV, CAC e performance por etapa.
  • Boa visão de experiência do cliente e comportamento em jornadas digitais.
  • Capacidade técnica para utilizar ou estruturar soluções com IA, agentes e automações aplicadas à conversão.
  • Boa comunicação e influência para atuar com stakeholders técnicos e de negócio.


Diferenciais valorizados

  • Experiência prévia em fintechs, crédito, cobrança, serviços financeiros ou operações B2C com alto volume de leads.
  • Vivência com desenho de experiências conversacionais e arquitetura de fluxos.
  • Experiência em produto, CX ou gestão de jornadas digitais.
  • Conhecimento em SQL, Supabase, Metabase, Power BI ou ferramentas similares.
  • Familiaridade com IA aplicada à personalização, qualificação e conversão em canais conversacionais.
  • Conhecimento em automação com N8N.
  • Experiência com plataformas conversacionais como Blip, ColmeIA ou similares.


Essa vaga NÃO é para você se:

  • Você é mais executor do que estrategista e não tem experiência otimizando funis de conversão.
  • Sua experiência está focada em social media, branding ou marketing de conteúdo.
  • Você trabalha apenas com análise de dados, sem transformar insights em ações práticas.
  • Sua atuação em growth é mais teórica do que prática (cursos, conceitos, pouca execução real).
  • Você nunca lidou com alto volume de leads ou operações em escala.
  • Seu foco é apenas aquisição (tráfego pago) e não conversão ao longo da jornada.
  • Você não tem experiência com chatbots, automação de mensagens ou fluxos conversacionais.
  • Você precisa de direcionamento constante e não tem autonomia para testar, iterar e tomar decisões.

title: Customer Success Associate

title: Quality Engineer (QE) — Automação- Sênior
description:

title: Senior Azure Cloud Engineer (Temporary Contract)
description:
About You

This is a high‑impact senior Azure Cloud / DevOps role supporting a Private Equity Group (PEG) platform. The team is greenfield, the infrastructure is new, and the customer is highly selective and security‑conscious. You must operate with strong autonomy, deep hands‑on Azure expertise, and the ability to own cloud architecture end‑to‑end. The expectation is to design, build, operate, and evolve production systems directly.


You will work closely with VP‑level technical stakeholders in an environment where reliability, deployment safety, and clarity in communication are essential. This position requires someone who can challenge assumptions constructively, explain architectural tradeoffs clearly , and operate effectively in ambiguous, early‑stage environments.


  • Note: This position is offered under a contractor model for a period of 6 months with the possibility of extension.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies

  • 5+ years of hands‑on Azure architecture experience, including subscription and resource group strategies, identity and access control (RBAC, managed identities), and end-to-end ownership of production Azure environments.
  • Strong experience designing and operating Azure networking, including VNets, subnets, NSGs, routing, private endpoints, and firewall concepts.
  • Hands‑on production experience with Azure PaaS services, including Azure App Services, Azure Database for PostgreSQL, Azure Front Door, and Azure Storage.
  • Expert-level Kubernetes and AKS operations , including cluster provisioning and upgrades, node pools, scaling strategies, networking integration (CNI, ingress), and workload isolation and security best practices.
  • Production-grade Terraform expertise, including modular design, environment separation, and state management with Azure backends.
  • Strong CI/CD automation experience integrating infrastructure as code and application deployments using Git-based pipelines.
  • Solid reliability engineering experience , including monitoring and alerting design, incident response and recovery, post-incident analysis, and the ability to reason about availability, scalability, cost optimization, and deployment safety.
  • Scripting ability using Bash and Python for automation and operational tooling.
  • Active use of AI-assisted engineering tools such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or Cloud Code to accelerate infrastructure development, incident response, and documentation.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to operate confidently with VP-level stakeholders during architectural reviews and operational incidents.
  • Advanced English proficiency, as you will work directly with US-based clients.


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities

  • Design and own Azure cloud architecture for a greenfield PEG platform , including subscription structure, networking, identity, and environment separation.
  • Build and operate AKS-based workloads and supporting Azure PaaS services , ensuring high availability and operational resilience.
  • Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure and application deployments, ensuring deployment safety and environment isolation.
  • Operate and evolve Terraform-driven infrastructure, maintaining modular design, clean state management, and consistent IaC practices across environments.
  • Design and maintain monitoring and alerting strategies across platform services, ensuring visibility into availability, performance, and reliability.
  • Lead troubleshooting and resolution of production issues, coordinate recovery efforts, and execute structured post-incident reviews.
  • Improve platform reliability, automation, and developer experience through proactive runbook creation and operational documentation.
  • Partner with security and engineering stakeholders on network policies, access controls, private connectivity, and compliance requirements.
  • Use AI tools to accelerate infrastructure automation, documentation, and deployment safety validation.
  • Challenge technical assumptions and advocate for scalable, secure, and cost-effective Azure architectures.
  • Communicate clearly and confidently during incidents and architectural reviews with VP-level technical stakeholders.


Qualifications

  • 5+ years in Azure cloud engineering or DevOps roles, with end-to-end ownership of production environments.

About Clinergy

Clinergy Health is a boutique CRO focused on delivering high-quality, highly tailored clinical development solutions for pharmaceutical and biotech companies.


We intentionally work with a small number of strategic projects, spanning Phase I to Real-World Evidence, to ensure scientific rigor, operational excellence, and true partnership with our clients.


Role Description

We are looking for a Contract Clinical Research Associate. The Clinical Research Associate will oversee and monitor assigned clinical trials, ensuring compliance with protocols and regulatory requirements. The role involves frequent collaboration with cross-functional teams and adherence to quality standards to meet project timelines.

  • Support and conduct preparation activities for Site Initiation Visits;

  • Conduct and tracks progress of site activities to initiation, enrolment and screening, interim monitoring and close out requirements;
  • Ensure no study tasks are conducted prior to IRB/EC approval and formal site activation;
  • Review Serious Adverse Event (SAE) narratives with sites and medical monitor; Ensure adverse event reporting is done in accordance with regulatory requirements;
  • Organize, conduct and report on Site Qualification, Site Initiation, Interim Monitoring, and Close-out visits;
  • Verify the accuracy of study results;
  • Identify and resolve site issues;


Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in life sciences;

  • Strong medical and clinical knowledge of indications, therapies, and patient population
  • Proven track record of having good sponsor, investigator, site, and vendor relations
  • Strong computer skills including EDC system experience
  • Demonstrated detailed knowledge of guidelines, systems for clinical trial management and of ICH GCP and international regulations and practices


Skills

  • Self driven individual
  • Sense of urgency
  • Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills
  • Attention to detail and strong organizational skills
  • Good problem solving skills
  • Enthusiastic and energetic

Estágio na área Financeira.

title: Data Scientist
description:
Mission Description:

Join our Advanced Analytics team as a Data Scientist in the Commercial Performance Tower. You will play a key role in designing, developing, and deploying scalable machine learning models that drive business impact. This is a hands-on role focused on model development, deployment, and optimization in real-world commercial environments.

About the Role:

We are seeking a skilled and proactive Data Scientist to strengthen our analytics capabilities. You will work on high-impact projects involving recommendation systems, demand forecasting, and predictive modeling using state-of-the-art techniques. The ideal candidate is passionate about turning data into actionable insights and has strong experience in model deployment within cloud environments (Azure, Databricks). You will collaborate closely with data engineers, ML engineers, and business stakeholders to deliver end-to-end data science solutions that optimize commercial performance.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and optimize recommendation systems (collaborative filtering, content-based, hybrid approaches)
  • Build and validate time series forecasting models using ARIMA, Prophet, LSTM, and other ML-based methods
  • Implement and tune boosting algorithms (XGBoost, LightGBM, CatBoost) and decision tree-based models for classification and regression tasks
  • Perform end-to-end data exploration, feature engineering, and model evaluation
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to deploy models into production on Azure and Databricks
  • Translate business problems into analytical frameworks and communicate results to technical and non-technical audiences
  • Stay current with emerging trends and tools in machine learning and data science

Profile Requirements:

Education:

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, or a related quantitative field

Experience & Skills:

  • Proven experience in recommender systems and time series forecasting
  • Strong expertise in boosting algorithms (XGBoost, etc.) and decision trees
  • Proficiency in Python and key libraries: scikit-learn, pandas, NumPy, statsmodels
  • Experience with Azure Machine Learning, Databricks, and cloud-based model deployment
  • Familiarity with C++ (a plus for performance-critical components)
  • Solid understanding of ML lifecycle, from prototyping to production
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment
  • Fluent in English (written and spoken) – essential for global collaboration

Why Join Us?

  • Be part of a high-performing analytics team driving real business impact
  • Work on cutting-edge machine learning applications in a dynamic commercial environment
  • Access to modern tools and cloud infrastructure (Azure, Databricks)
  • Opportunities for growth within the Mantu Group ecosystem

  • Diagnose and resolve performance bottlenecks, accessibility issues, and cross-browser inconsistencies
  • Mentor junior and mid-level engineers through pair programming, code reviews, and knowledge-sharing sessions
  • Own release planning, CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing strategies to maintain >90 % test coverage

  • 5+ years of production experience with React and modern JavaScript/TypeScript

title: Executive Assistant
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a highly organized, proactive Executive Assistant to provide comprehensive administrative support to our executive team. This role is key in ensuring smooth coordination, communication, and operational efficiency across the organization.

Key responsibilities

  • Efficiently manage and prioritize executive calendars, schedules, appointments, and travel arrangements.
  • Draft, edit, and prepare professional documents including emails, memos, reports, and presentations.
  • Screen and prioritize incoming communication to ensure timely responses and proper direction.
  • Coordinate and organize meetings, conferences, and events, including all logistics and materials preparation.
  • Take clear and accurate meeting minutes, distribute them, and follow up on action items.
  • Maintain confidential files, records, and databases with high accuracy and discretion.
  • Build positive relationships with internal staff, clients, partners, and key stakeholders.
  • Act as liaison between executives and internal/external parties to ensure effective communication.
  • Support special projects, research, and analysis assigned by the executives.
  • Identify opportunities for process improvement and implement efficient administrative systems.

Qualifications and skills

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Management, or related field (preferred).
  • Proven experience as an Executive Assistant or in a similar administrative role.
  • Trilingual proficiency: Spanish, English, and Portuguese (required).
  • Exceptional organizational, prioritization, and time-management skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication abilities.
  • Strong proficiency with productivity tools (Microsoft Office / Teams / Outlook).
  • Research and project management skills.
  • High level of professionalism, confidentiality, and discretion when handling sensitive information.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to deliver high-quality work within deadlines.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills and ability to build relationships at all levels.
  • Proactive mindset with strong problem‑solving abilities.
  • Flexibility and adaptability to shifting priorities and work demands.
  • Industry/sector knowledge is a plus.

About Kerry

Kerry is the world's leading taste and nutrition company for the food, beverage and pharmaceutical industries. Every day we partner with customers to create healthier, tastier and more sustainable products that are consumed by billions of people across the world. Our vision is to be our customers' most valued partner, creating a world of sustainable nutrition. A career with Kerry offers you an opportunity to shape the future of food while providing you opportunities to explore and grow in a truly global environment.

title: Especialista CX - Afirmativa PCD
description:
Nossa área de Customer Experience (CX) é uma das principais alavancas de retenção e eficiência do grupo. Responsável por garantir que a jornada do cliente seja fluida, o time de CX atua na intersecção entre as áreas de Comercial, Implantação e Suporte, transformando indicadores em projetos estratégicos de otimização operacional.


Como Especialista de CX e Qualidade operacional, você trabalhará com equipes multifuncionais para identificar gargalos que impactam a experiência do cliente e a performance do negócio. Você será o guardião dos Fóruns de Qualidade, liderando os esforços desde o diagnóstico de indicadores até a implementação de novos fluxos de trabalho.


É uma função de ritmo acelerado e alta visibilidade, onde o foco é a resolução de problemas complexos. O Especialista lidera a conexão entre os silos da organização, a consolidação de processos de atendimento e a transferência de boas práticas entre os times para garantir que o cliente alcance o sucesso no menor tempo possível.


Responsabilidades e Atribuições:

  • Liderar os Fóruns de CX e Operações: Garantir o ótimo relacionamento com os líderes de Comercial, Suporte e Implantação, alinhando metas, processos e comunicação.
  • Gestão de Indicadores: Analisar e reportar o progresso de métricas críticas (TTV, CSAT, Throughput, Tempo de Resposta) em relação aos objetivos de negócio.
  • Mapeamento de Jornada: Desenhar processos e modelos de atendimento, identificando proativamente oportunidades de otimização e redução de atrito para o cliente.
  • Gestão de Projetos de Melhoria: Desenvolver e acompanhar planos de ação pós-diagnóstico, garantindo que as melhorias discutidas sejam implementadas e gerem o valor esperado.
  • Mitigação de Riscos: Identificar gargalos operacionais que possam gerar churn ou queda de satisfação e ajustar os planos de execução conforme necessário.
  • Voz do Cliente: Assegurar a disseminação de feedbacks qualitativos para toda a organização, influenciando a evolução do produto e do serviço.
  • Report Estratégico: Comunicar o progresso das iniciativas de CX e os ganhos de eficiência para os stakeholders e lideranças.


Requisitos e Qualificações:

  • 5+ anos de experiência em Customer Experience, CX Ops ou Gestão de Projetos Operacionais.
  • Experiência em mapeamento de processos e desenho de jornadas de cliente.
  • Comunicação verbal e escrita clara, objetiva e com foco em dados.
  • Capacidade de engajar e liderar pessoas e áreas, independente de subordinação hierárquica (influência lateral).
  • Perfil analítico e executor: Conforto em navegar entre dashboards e a implementação prática de processos.
  • Desejável conhecimento em metodologias ágeis ou melhoria contínua (Lean, Six Sigma ou Design Thinking).
  • Formação superior completa.

Location / Remote: Remote -- Candidates who reside outside the United States will be considered.

Time Zone: Must be willing to work Eastern Timezone Hours

Communication: Only candidates with professional-level English proficiency will be considered.

Employment Type: 12-month contract (W-2, C2C).

Compensation: Up to 33 U.S. dollars per hour (depending on experience).

This role focuses on designing and delivering enterprise-grade AI-driven automation solutions. The Agentic Solutions Architect will play a hands-on role in architecting secure, scalable, and production-ready intelligent automation systems that integrate AI agents, enterprise platforms, APIs, and data systems. Success in this position requires deep technical expertise, a strong understanding of automation architecture, and the ability to guide teams in implementing innovative AI solutions.

Responsibilities:

  • Architect enterprise-grade intelligent automation solutions integrating AI agents, APIs, and enterprise platforms.
  • Design and implement multi-step workflows involving AI agents, RPA bots, and enterprise applications.
  • Establish architecture patterns for orchestration, exception handling, approvals, and auditability.
  • Leverage Microsoft Copilot and Power Platform AI tools, including Copilot Studio and Power Automate.
  • Architect secure integrations between AI agents, automation platforms, and enterprise data systems, particularly Databricks.
  • Provide technical leadership and guidance to development teams.
  • Evaluate emerging agent technologies and recommend best practices for adoption.
  • Develop repeatable architecture standards, patterns, and governance practices for AI automation.

Required Skills:

  • 7+ years of experience in solution architecture, enterprise automation architecture, or similar roles.
  • Proven experience delivering AI-driven or intelligent automation solutions in production environments.
  • Hands-on expertise with Microsoft Copilot / Power Platform AI capabilities (e.G., Copilot Studio, Power Automate).
  • Familiarity with Azure AI services or Microsoft AI Foundry.
  • Strong experience designing API-driven integrations and distributed automation architectures.
  • Experience integrating automation solutions with enterprise data platforms, with a preference for Databricks.
  • Ability to design secure, scalable, and production-ready AI automation solutions.

Preferred Skills:

  • Experience with enterprise RPA platforms such as UiPath or similar.
  • Experience designing multi-agent workflows or human-in-the-loop automation systems.
  • Experience supporting enterprise Automation or AI Centers of Excellence.
  • Expertise in establishing architecture standards, reusable components, and automation governance frameworks.

title: Business Development Manager (Bdm) - Forex Brokerage
description:
Disruptive Talents, a boutique headhunting and strategic recruitment firm, is collaborating with an international Forex brokerage to identify a Business Development Manager (BDM) – Brazil.

At Disruptive Talents, we connect commercially driven talent with high-growth financial services organizations. This search is conducted on behalf of an international Forex brokerage seeking to accelerate client acquisition, strategic partnerships, and revenue growth across the Brazilian and Latin American markets.

This is a strategic opportunity to join the commercial growth team at a critical stage of the company's expansion in Brazil, playing a central role in developing client relationships, strategic partnerships, and long-term revenue growth in the local market.

About the Company

A regulated international Forex brokerage operating across multiple jurisdictions, the company provides trading access and infrastructure solutions to professional traders, institutional clients, introducing brokers (IBs), asset managers, and strategic partners. With a growing global footprint and a strong emphasis on technology, compliance, and scalable brokerage solutions, the firm continues to expand its presence in key regional markets, including Colombia, Mexico and Brazil.

As a Business Development Manager, you will focus on expanding the company's footprint among professional traders, institutional clients, introducing brokers (IBs), asset managers, and strategic partners.

The ideal candidate brings a strong understanding of financial markets, brokerage products, and client trading needs, paired with a consultative, relationship-led sales approach.

What You Will Do:

Business Growth & Revenue

  • Identify, develop, and close new business opportunities across FX, CFDs, equities, derivatives, or multi-asset trading solutions.
  • Drive revenue growth through direct client acquisition and strategic partnerships (IBs, affiliates, money managers).
  • Own the full sales cycle: prospecting, pitching, negotiation, onboarding coordination, and account growth.
  • Achieve and exceed individual and team revenue targets.

Client & Partner Management

  • Build long-term relationships with professional traders, institutional clients, and high-value partners.
  • Act as a trusted commercial advisor, aligning client trading needs with platform capabilities, pricing, and liquidity solutions.
  • Support retention and account expansion by identifying cross-sell and upsell opportunities.

Market & Industry Intelligence

  • Stay current on global financial market trends, trading technologies, and competitor offerings.
  • Monitor regulatory developments (e.G., MiFID II, FCA, CySEC, ASIC) and ensure commercial activity aligns with compliance requirements.
  • Represent the company at industry events, conferences, and client meetings.

Internal Collaboration

  • Work closely with trading, liquidity, risk, compliance, and operations teams to ensure seamless client onboarding and service delivery.
  • Partner with marketing to support lead-generation campaigns and regional growth initiatives.
  • Maintain accurate pipeline management, forecasts, and performance reporting via CRM tools.

What We Are Looking For:

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Business, or a related field.
  • 3–7+ years of business development, sales, or relationship management experience within financial markets brokerage (FX, CFDs, equities, crypto, or derivatives).
  • Strong understanding of trading platforms, brokerage revenue models, and client acquisition channels.
  • Proven track record of meeting or exceeding revenue targets.
  • Deep interest in financial markets and trading products.
  • Strong negotiation and closing skills.
  • Relationship-driven, consultative sales mindset.
  • Excellent communication and presentation abilities.
  • Highly organized, data-driven, and comfortable working with CRM and reporting tools.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive base salary plus performance-based commission.
  • Exposure to global financial markets and high-value clients.
  • Clear career progression in a fast-growing brokerage environment.
  • Collaborative, performance-oriented culture.

How to Apply:

  • If you thrive in fast-moving financial markets and enjoy building profitable, long-term client relationships, we'd love to hear from you

title: Customer Success Associate
description:
About AdManage.Ai Type: Full-Time We're building the Cursor for ad management.

AdManage.Ai helps companies launch ads 10x faster on Meta & TikTok. Created by top performance marketers who've managed over $50M+ in ad spend, our mission is to level the playing field by giving every business access to enterprise-grade ad automation tools.

Our platform launches 900,000+ ads per month, saving advertisers hours with bulk ad creation, creative mining, and AI-powered campaign tools. We're profitable, fast-moving, and backed by experience — not just ideas.

The Mission Our users are ambitious brands and agencies who rely on us not just for software, but for expertise that helps them scale profitably. That's where you come in.

We're looking for a Junior Customer Success Manager with a media buying background who can bridge the gap between software and performance marketing. You'll ensure our customers get real outcomes with AdManage.Ai — not just features. You'll be supported by a strong CS team and learn fast.

What You'll Do

  • Support onboarding: help guide new customers from setup to first wins alongside senior team members.
  • Be a go-to resource: use your media buying knowledge to answer questions on campaign structure, creative testing, and platform features.
  • Drive adoption: help customers unlock the full value of features like bulk ad launching, creative mining, and performance dashboards.
  • Build relationships: be a reliable, friendly point of contact for brands, agencies, and growth teams.
  • Close the feedback loop: surface customer pain points to our product and engineering teams. We ship continuously — your insights will hit production fast.
  • Help reduce churn: flag at-risk accounts early and work with the team to find solutions.

What We're Looking For

  • At least 6 months of experience in a customer-facing role (CSM, account management, support, or similar in a SaaS company).
  • Strong communication skills — you're confident on Google Meet, email, and Slack.
  • Comfortable using AI tools in your day-to-day workflow, including Claude Code for automating repetitive tasks, drafting customer communications, or building lightweight internal tools.
  • Startup mentality: eager to learn, comfortable with ambiguity, and happy to wear multiple hats.
  • Curiosity, empathy, and a bias for action are non-negotiable.

Bonus Points For

  • Familiarity with Meta Ads Manager or TikTok Ads at a campaign level
  • Any exposure to SaaS tools or ad tech platforms
  • Experience using Claude Code or similar agentic AI tools to automate workflows
  • Prior internship or junior role at a startup or agency
  • Some hands-on experience with paid social (Meta, TikTok) — whether through internships, agency work, freelance, or running your own campaigns.

Why Join Us

  • Join an amazing Customer Success team and grow fast.
  • Direct impact: your feedback shapes our product roadmap from day one.
  • Work alongside founders who've scaled brands like ZOE, Photoroom, and Nextdoor.

How to Apply Send your LinkedIn and 2–3 lines on: What's a performance marketing challenge you've helped solve — or one you're fascinated by? Bonus: any results or campaigns you're proud of, however small.

title: Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
Uma das pioneiras em soluções de inteligência de dados no Open Finance, a klavi é uma das instituições que mais cresce nesse ecossistema, levando inovação através de dados a milhares de brasileiros. A klavi utiliza tecnologia própria e de ponta para viabilizar a coleta de dados, além de automatizar todo o processamento desses dados para transformá-los em valor de negócio.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Engenheiro(a) de QA com foco em garantir a qualidade, confiabilidade e desempenho das soluções desenvolvidas pela Klavi. Essa pessoa atuará de forma colaborativa com os times de produto e engenharia, contribuindo para a definição de cenários de teste, automação de testes, identificação e prevenção de bugs em todas as etapas do desenvolvimento. O objetivo é assegurar que nossas entregas atendam aos mais altos padrões de qualidade, proporcionando uma excelente experiência para os usuários finais.

Cultura da klavi

  • Busca constante pela excelência: Somos automotivados, nunca satisfeitos e sempre buscando melhorias. Cada pessoa deve ser um especialista na empresa e em seu segmento. Nós elevamos continuamente o nível para fornecer produtos, serviços e processos de alta qualidade.
  • Inovar para revolucionar: Encorajamos as pessoas a serem curiosas e a desafiarem o status quo. Ouvimos sempre novas ideias e estamos abertos a perguntas. Não temos medo de mudanças.
  • Construção e valorização coletiva: Colabore com seus colegas e celebrem juntos as vitórias. Sejam transparentes, respeitosos e confiem uns nos outros. Nós não reclamamos, mas encontramos soluções juntos.
  • Foco no sucesso do cliente: Nosso sucesso está enraizado no sucesso dos nossos clientes. Sempre nos esforçamos para superar suas expectativas. Buscamos fornecer as melhores soluções e valores a longo prazo.

Salário

  • Regime: PJ
  • Salário: Competitivo
  • Nível: Especialista

Principais responsabilidades

  • Investigar e diagnosticar falhas, identificando a causa raiz de bugs e inconsistências no sistema.
  • Criar suítes de testes com base nos requisitos funcionais e não funcionais das features.
  • Implementar testes automatizados para garantir a cobertura e a confiabilidade de novas funcionalidades.
  • Validar o estado do sistema antes de implantações, garantindo que todos os ambientes estejam estáveis e prontos para release.
  • Ter um entendimento profundo dos fluxos atuais do sistema para antecipar riscos e propor melhorias de qualidade.
  • Monitorar continuamente a saúde e o desempenho das aplicações, atuando preventivamente em casos de instabilidade.

Requisitos necessários:

  • Inglês avançado – Será necessário para se comunicar com times internacionais, participar de reuniões técnicas e colaborar em projetos globais.
  • Formação acadêmica na área de computação – Graduação completa ou em andamento em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência com os testes automatizados
  • Disponibilidade para trabalho presencial – Atuação no escritório da Klavi em São Paulo, em modelo híbrido ou presencial, conforme combinado.
  • Tech Stack: Python, Java, Golang, AWS (EKS, SQS, SNS), PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, Redis, Git, Jenkins, Grafana

Nossos benefícios:

title: Analista De Segurança Da Informação Sênior
description:
Prazer, Grupo SBF

Para nós, esporte é mais que só a prática: é movimento. Ele tem o poder de mover as pessoas pelo exercício, pela paixão pelo time do coração, pela diversão de uma aula de dança, pela força de marcas icônicas. Por vermos a potência do esporte em todas as suas expressões, trabalhamos juntos com garra e energia para construir o primeiro ecossistema de esporte do mundo, reunindo diversas possibilidades para que as pessoas sejam envolvidas e impactadas pelo poder de se movimentar. Quando você pensar em esporte, pode ter certeza: o Grupo SBF estará ali. Seja por meio das lojas e do e-commerce da Centauro, a maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina;
da Fisia, distribuidoraoficial da Nike no Brasil, da FitDance e da OneFan, aqui o movimento não para. Praticante ou entusiasta, fã ou apaixonado: o Grupo SBF é pra você. Somos saudavelmente inconformados, fazedores e convictos da importância de levar o movimento para cada vez mais gente. Se você se move por esporte, ou é movido por ele, temos um convite: que tal também trabalhar por ele?

Ficou interessado(a)? Vem saber mais!

Dia a dia:

Foco: Governança, Riscos, Controles e Regulamentações

Atuar de forma estratégica no fortalecimento da governança de Segurança da Informação, assegurando aderência a regulamentações, frameworks e normas aplicáveis (LGPD, PCI DSS, ISO 27001/27002, NIST, entre outras), promovendo gestão eficaz de riscos, controles internos e conformidade regulatória em alinhamento com os objetivos do negócio.

Principais Responsabilidades:

Governança e Compliance

  • Desenvolver, revisar e manter políticas, normas e procedimentos de Segurança da Informação.
  • Garantir aderência a frameworks como ISO 27001/27002, NIST CSF, CIS Controls e PCI DSS.
  • Apoiar e conduzir auditorias internas e externas.
  • Atuar na sustentação de certificações e avaliações regulatórias.
  • Apoiar o programa de adequação e sustentação à LGPD.
  • Apoiar na avaliação de Privacy by Design e Security by Design.

Gestão de Riscos e Controles

  • Conduzir análises de riscos de segurança (técnicos, operacionais e regulatórios).
  • Definir, implementar e monitorar controles internos de segurança.
  • Avaliar riscos de terceiros e fornecedores críticos.
  • Elaborar planos de tratamento de riscos e acompanhar sua execução.
  • Manter matriz de riscos atualizada e integrada à estratégia corporativa.

Regulamentações e Normas

  • Atuar nos temas relacionados a PCI DSS.
  • Garantir aderência a requisitos regulatórios (LGPD, normas contratuais).
  • Traduzir requisitos regulatórios em controles técnicos e processuais aplicáveis.
  • Apoiar áreas de negócio na interpretação de requisitos de segurança.

Integração com Áreas Internas

  • Trabalhar em parceria com Jurídico, Compliance, Auditoria, Tecnologia, Privacidade e áreas de negócio.
  • Apoiar comitês de risco e segurança.
  • Contribuir com indicadores, dashboards executivos e relatórios estratégicos.

Perfil Esperado

  • Visão estratégica de segurança alinhada ao negócio.
  • Forte capacidade analítica e de priorização baseada em risco.
  • Comunicação clara para públicos técnicos e executivos.
  • Capacidade de estruturar processos e elevar maturidade organizacional.
  • Mentalidade colaborativa e orientada a governança preventiva.

Requisitos Técnicos

Obrigatórios:

  • Experiência sólida em Governança, Riscos e Compliance (GRC).
  • Vivência com ISO 27001/27002 e/ou NIST.
  • Experiência em auditorias e avaliação de controles.
  • Conhecimento em gestão de riscos corporativos.

Diferenciais:

  • Certificações como: CISM, CRISC, ISO 27001 LA/LI, PCI ISA.
  • Experiência em varejo, e-commerce ou meios de pagamento.
  • Experiência com PCI DSS
  • Experiência com ferramentas de GRC.

Indicadores de Sucesso

  • Evolução do nível de maturidade em segurança.
  • Redução de riscos críticos.
  • Aderência comprovada a PCI DSS e demais normas.
  • Redução de não conformidades em auditorias.
  • Fortalecimento da cultura de governança e controles.

Contexto de Atuação

A posição integra o White Team, com foco em governança, prevenção, controles e maturidade do programa de Segurança da Informação, atuando de forma estratégica e transversal com múltiplas áreas de negócio.

title: Data Consultant Brazil
description:
The current vacancy is for the Brazilian office and we work in a Free Office model.

Come join us!

title: Data Scientist - Sênior (Motor De Busca)
description:
No Grupo SBF, reunimos duas grandes forças do esporte no Brasil: a Centauro, maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina, e a Fisia, distribuidora oficial da Nike no país.

Queremos ser referência em esporte no Brasil e construir um futuro em que cada experiência com o esporte inspire, motive e transforme.

E aí, que tal vestir essa camisa com a gente?

Buscamos uma pessoa Cientista de Dados para atuar na squad de Busca, com foco em Busca Semântica, relevância e ranking. Essa posição tem papel estratégico na evolução da experiência de busca, atuando desde a definição de hipóteses até a implementação, experimentação e mensuração de impacto, com forte interface com Produto, Engenharia e Negócio.

Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver e evoluir soluções de Busca Semântica utilizando Elasticsearch, indo além da busca lexical tradicional.
  • Atuar na definição e otimização de: Estrutura de índices e mappings Estratégias de ranking híbrido (lexical + semântico) Queries semânticas (ex: embeddings, similarity search, boosting contextual)
  • Trabalhar com vetorização de conteúdo (produtos, termos de busca, atributos) para melhoria de relevância.
  • Avaliar e evoluir métricas de qualidade de busca. Conduzir testes A/B e experimentos controlados para validar impacto das melhorias semânticas. Traduzir problemas de negócio e experiência do usuário em soluções analíticas e modelos de dados.
  • Atuar em parceria com Engenharia e Produto na definição do roadmap técnico de busca. Garantir boas práticas de ciência de dados: versionamento, documentação, reprodutibilidade e monitoramento.
  • Apoiar tecnicamente outros cientistas de dados do time, elevando o nível das discussões técnicas.

Requisitos necessários

  • Formação superior completa em Ciência da Computação, Estatística, Matemática ou áreas afins. Experiência comprovada de 5 a 7 anos em projetos de ciência de dados.
  • Experiência prática com Busca Semântica em Elasticsearch
  • Experiência com Information Retrieval (IR) e conceitos de relevância.
  • Conhecimento em NLP aplicado à busca (ex: embeddings, similaridade textual).
  • Experiência com modelos de ranking ou learning to rank.
  • Domínio de SQL para análise de grandes volumes de dados.
  • Proficiência em Python para análise de dados, experimentação e modelagem.
  • Vivência com experimentação e testes A/B em ambientes de produto.
  • Capacidade de comunicação clara com públicos técnicos e não técnicos.
  • Experiência em produtos digitais com alto volume de dados. Noções de MLOps.

  • Validate PMC multiplexing on FreeBSD
  • Validate proper PMC attach functionality to existing processes
  • Design and automate test scenarios across various performance monitoring frameworks
  • Collaborate with kernel engineers to analyze results, identify issues, and propose fixes or improvements
  • Maintain documentation, test plans, and validation reports
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of automation frameworks and test coverage

Mandatory Skills Description:

  • 3-5 years of relevant experience
  • Hands-on experience with modern Unix/Linux kernel validation (FreeBSD kernel validation is a strong bonus)
  • Strong understanding of performance management frameworks (e.G., PMCs, perf, hardware performance counters)
  • Solid understanding of x86 architecture, especially performance monitoring hardware
  • Excellent automation and scripting skills (Python, Shell, or similar)
  • Experience designing and implementing automated test cases for performance monitoring frameworks
  • Ability to work with low-level debugging, instrumentation, and system performance tools

title: Software Engineer In Test

title: Customer Success Coordinator/Account Manager

Preferred

This position is not just support—it is a force multiplier. By owning recurring customer and data workflows, this role directly enables Headshots.Com to scale accounts, improve retention, and transition from manual effort to system-driven growth.

All candidates must apply via LinkedIn. Direct contact with Headshots.Com regarding this position will not be considered and may result in disqualification from the process.

title: Arquiteto De Soluções - Com Foco Em Ia
description:

- Garantir que as soluções atendam requisitos de segurança, governança de dados, escalabilidade e observabilidade.

Nosso jeito de trabalhar, buscamos pessoas que:

- Invistam continuamente em aprendizado e evolução técnica.

- Conectem tecnologia e negócio para gerar impacto real.

title: Immigration Attorney (Us-Licensed)
description:
About the job

POSITION SPECIFICATION

Position Title: Immigration Attorney (US license is required)

Reporting To: Chief Supervising Attorney

Location: Hybrid (Preferred location: Brazil)

The Company: HAYMAN-WOODWARD GMS

ABOUT US

HAYMAN-WOODWARD GMS is a globally recognized immigration and advisory firm. Based in Dubai, UAE, with offices across 9 countries, we specialize in facilitating seamless global transitions for individuals and businesses. Our expertise in U.S. employment-based immigration law positions us uniquely to navigate complex immigration procedures, enabling our clients to flourish in their chosen international markets.

POSITION SUMMARY

As an Immigration Attorney, you will be instrumental in guiding clients through the multifaceted immigration process. Your role demands a comprehensive understanding of immigration law and exceptional client service skills, ensuring successful outcomes in various legal scenarios. Your responsibilities include:

  • Client Consultation and Advocacy: Providing personalized legal consultation, understanding each client's unique needs, and advising on the most viable legal options. Your role involves zealous representation of clients' interests, maintaining transparent communication, and filing G-28s on their behalf. Representation includes evaluation of complex eligibility and admissibility issues, RFE/NOID prevention strategy, participation in legal strategy meetings.
  • Case Management and Strategy Development: Leading a diverse range of immigration cases from inception to resolution. This includes strategizing tailored solutions, analyzing case specifics, and foreseeing potential challenges to address them proactively.
  • Preparation and Submission of Cases: Crafting compelling petitions for various immigration applications such as work visas, family-based petitions, adjustment of status, and naturalization. Your meticulous attention to detail is crucial in ensuring accuracy and compliance with current immigration laws. This also involves staying abreast of legal developments and preparing detailed legal briefs and reports.
  • Collaboration and Team Leadership: Working in tandem with paralegals, legal assistants, and other attorneys. You will mentor and oversee junior staff to ensure high-quality, timely casework.
  • Response to Legal Queries: Addressing Requests for Additional Evidence (RFEs), Notices of Intent to Deny (NOIDs), and Notices of Intent to Revoke (NOIRs) from government agencies through detailed analysis and preparation of persuasive responses.
  • Appeals and Legal Motions: Managing appeals and motions to reconsider or reopen cases, crafting comprehensive legal arguments to uphold client positions.

EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS AND EDUCATIONAL BACKGROUND

  • J.D. from an ABA-approved law school.
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in employment-based immigration law.
  • An active member in good standing with a state Bar, with eligibility to represent clients and sign G-28s.
  • Proficiency in EB1, EB2-NIW, O1, PERM labor certifications, H-1B, L-1, and E visa matters.
  • Fluency in a second language is desirable.
  • Supervisory Responsibility: Yes, including oversight of cases and potential supervision of paralegals and case managers.

KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS

  • Adept at persuasive legal writing and advocacy.
  • Detail-oriented with strong organizational skills.
  • Excellent communication, customer service, and writing abilities.
  • Ability to work independently or collaboratively within a team.

APPLICATION PROCEDURES

  • Start Date: Immediate.
  • Work Schedule: Monday to Friday, 9:30 AM - 6:30 PM.
  • Location: Remote.
  • Compensation & Benifits:

-Competitive salary

-Home office allowance

-Health insurance (after probation period)

-Dental plan

-CLT employment contract with full statutory benefits

  • Current clients or family members of employees are not eligible.
  • Email your resume and cover letter in PDF format to, referencing\ "Immigration Attorney position".

Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

Esta vaga irá atender um cliente global do segmento de energia, com forte atuação em projetos de tecnologia e inovação, inserido em um ambiente corporativo robusto, com operações críticas e times distribuídos globalmente. O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Atuar com arquivamento de dados e documentos em SAP (ADK/AIS), incluindo execução e recuperação (PrintList, Inbound e Outbound)

O que você precisa ter

  • Vivência com objetos de arquivamento (FI_DOCUMNT, SD_VBAK, CO_ITEM, entre outros)
  • Experiência com suporte L2/L3 (incident e problem management)

  • Experiência com monitoramento e automação (ex: Datadog, PowerShell)

  • Experiência com jobs de housekeeping e data archiving
  • Inglês avançado para atuação em ambiente global

Será um destaque seu perfil com:

  • Experiência com Azure DevOps e ServiceNow
  • Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban)
  • Perfil colaborativo, proativo e com boa comunicação

Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in Node.Js backend development.
  • Experience working with legacy systems, system stabilization, or technical recovery projects.
  • Strong experience with AWS, CI/CD pipelines, and PostgreSQL.
  • Solid understanding of backend security and API integrations.
  • Advanced English proficiency.

Additional Information

About Us
