A Aggrandize nasceu em 2015 com a missão de engrandecer pessoas e negócios. Guiados por valores como adaptabilidade, colaboração, foco no cliente e visão de dono, oferecemos soluções que transformam desafios em oportunidades.

Somos especialistas em Platform Engineering, Data Analytics, Modern Applications e Cybersecurity, sempre com o compromisso de impulsionar o crescimento e a inovação de nossos parceiros.

Nosso trabalho é mais do que tecnologia;
é sobre potencializar resultados. Increase the power of your business.

Agora que você conhece a cultura Aggrandize, saiba mais sobre a oportunidade:

Estamos em busca de um (a) Engenheiro (a) de Software com IA para projetar, desenvolver e evoluir soluções que utilizam Inteligência Artificial e Machine Learning, atuando de ponta a ponta, da concepção técnica até a implementação em produção.

Essa pessoa trabalhará em conjunto com times de produto, dados e negócios para transformar desafios reais em soluções escaláveis, seguras e de alto impacto.

O seu papel no time:

  • Projetar e desenvolver aplicações de software que incorporem modelos de IA e Machine Learning;
  • Integrar modelos de IA a sistemas existentes, APIs, pipelines de dados e arquiteturas distribuídas;
  • Colaborar com cientistas de dados e engenheiros de dados na construção, treinamento, versionamento e deploy de modelos;
  • Implementar práticas de MLOps, garantindo automação, monitoramento, rastreabilidade e escalabilidade dos modelos em produção;
  • Desenvolver soluções baseadas em LLMs (Large Language Models) como chatbots, sistemas de recomendação, classificação, busca semântica e automação inteligente;
  • Garantir qualidade de código, segurança, performance e boas práticas de engenharia de software;
  • Participar de decisões de arquitetura, revisões técnicas e definição de padrões;
  • Atuar na melhoria contínua das soluções, avaliando métricas de performance dos modelos e do software;
  • Documentar soluções técnicas e compartilhar conhecimento com o time.

O que esperamos de você - Hard Skills:

  • Sólida experiência em engenharia de software (backend e/ou full stack);
  • Proficiência emlinguagens como Python, Java, Go, JavaScript ou TypeScript;
  • Experiência comframeworks e bibliotecas de IA e Machine Learning (TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn, LangChain ou Hugging Face);
  • Conhecimento emAPIs, microserviços e arquiteturas orientadas a eventos;
  • Experiência comcloud computing (Google Cloud ou Azure);
  • Familiaridade com containers e orquestração (Docker, Kubernetes);
  • Conhecimento embancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais;
  • Experiência comversionamento de código (Git) e práticas de CI/CD.

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência prática com LLMs, GenAI, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) e fine-tuning de modelos;
  • Conhecimento emferramentas de dados como Databricks, BigQuery ou Spark;
  • Experiência comMLOps (MLflow, Kubeflow ou Vertex AI);
  • Vivência em ambientes de alta escala ou sistemas críticos;
  • Conhecimento emsegurança aplicada à IA e governança de dados;
  • Experiência prévia em produtos digitais orientados a dados.

O que esperamos de você - Soft Skills:

title: Analista Processos Regulatorios Jr
description:

- Apoiar na gestão e manutenção de aplicações em Power Apps utilizadas pela área.

- Atualizar e alimentar painéis e relatórios de indicadores, assegurando a visibilidade dos processos regulatórios.

- Acompanhar e registrar novas portarias, normas e legislações, mantendo as bases de dados atualizadas.

- Dar suporte técnico e operacional ao time, auxiliando na interpretação de informações regulatórias e organização de documentos.

- Contribuir para a organização de dados e informações sensíveis, garantindo precisão, segurança e rastreabilidade.

- Apoiar na preparação de documentações e materiais para auditorias, diligências ou visitas regulatórias.

- Eventualmente, poderá participar de viagens para suporte em atividades da área.

Requisitos e qualificações

- Organização e atenção a detalhes no tratamento de dados e informações.

- Conhecimento ou familiaridade com Excel (controles e bases de dados).

- Experiência ou interesse em Power Apps e gestão de indicadores/painéis será considerado um diferencial.

- Boa comunicação e capacidade de trabalho colaborativo.

Informações adicionais

O que você pode esperar da gente?

  • Participação nos lucros: resultados com comemoração fazem parte do jeito Cogna.
  • Vale-refeição ou alimentação: num cartão de benefícios flexível.
  • Assistência médica: um abrangente plano de saúde, com inclusão de dependentes e coparticipação.

Aqui, acreditamos no respeito, na diversidade e na busca da inclusão em todas suas frentes. Todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados independentemente de raça, gênero, identidade, expressão de gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, genética, deficiência ou de qualquer outra base.

Nosso propósito é avançar cada vez mais, gerando empregabilidade para talentos diversos. Venha enriquecer nosso time!

title: Desenvolvedor (A) Fullstack Pleno - Neppo
description:

title: Senior Content Manager
description:
As a Senior Content Manager, you will play a key role in supporting MoveUp Media's growth by owning the operational and strategic execution of content across our website portfolio. You will take ownership of content performance and strategy across our websites, while leading day-to-day content operations and working closely with SEO and cross-functional teams. You will be responsible for turning content and SEO strategies into measurable results, while ensuring high-quality standards across multi-language teams and markets.

This role contributes directly to the CORE department's objectives by supporting the growth, stability, and diversification of the business through content performance, strong processes, and effective collaboration. You will act as the main point of ownership for content quality and delivery, working closely with SEO, Product, and cross-functional teams.

To be more specific, you will:

  • Lead and develop the content strategy for our flagship, multi-language websites across multiple markets
  • Manage content workflows and ensure consistent, high-quality output across all sites
  • Oversee content quality, structure, and standards across our portfolio
  • Work proactively with content teams to define and implement content checklists and best practices
  • Collaborate closely with SEO, Tech, Design, and Product teams to ensure content and SEO best practices are followed
  • Ensure all SEO and content checks are completed ahead of website launches or redesigns
  • Regularly review websites to identify issues, suggest improvements, and support teams with implementation
  • Monitor content performance and report progress and key initiatives to senior stakeholders
  • Ensure content meets compliance and regulatory requirements and oversee necessary updates
  • Stay up to date with market trends, best practices, and iGaming innovations
  • Support hiring and team development (mentoring) in collaboration with Talent Acquisition and HR.

The ideal profile

We're looking for a Senior Content Manager ready to step into a Lead role — someone who takes ownership of content performance, works independently, and collaborates closely with SEO to drive results.

You are someone who:

  • Has 3+ years of experience in a senior content or content leadership role
  • Has iGaming experience (a strong plus, not a must)
  • Has a background in journalism, communications, or a related field (a plus)
  • Has an excellent command of English and a strong eye for content quality and consistency
  • Is comfortable reviewing and optimising content rather than writing it

You bring strong CM fundamentals:

  • High level of autonomy and strong task prioritisation skills
  • Ownership mindset over site and content performance
  • Ability to analyse performance data and turn insights into clear actions
  • Strategic thinking and the ability to plan toward defined goals
  • Experience working with CMS platforms

You work well with others and think ahead:

  • Collaborative approach, especially when working with SEO teams
  • Proactive in sharing ideas, flagging issues, and suggesting improvements
  • Open to experimentation, innovation, and continuous improvement
  • Positive attitude with a growth mindset and leadership potential

Feeling up to the task of managing the main challenges of the role, even without meeting all criteria? We're eager to hear from you! We know not all great candidates will match 100% of the above.

Next steps in the process

  • 1rst Interview with your future manager to make sure you meet the role's requirements
  • 2nd interview with HR to better understand who you are and make sure there is a cultural fit with MoveUp Media
  • Last step: a proposition for us to start working together!

What's in it for you

  • A full time remote work environment.
  • A flexible schedule and paid time off. We measure results, not hours.
  • Competitive salary, depending on your level of seniority in the role and your location
  • Development opportunities. As a startup with rapid growth, there are a lot of possibilities that can arise and we are committed to accompany our team members in their career path.
  • Yearly get together with the team to connect, work and have fun. We strive to find good spots for everyone to enjoy the stay!

MoveUp Media

We're a dynamic and driven team that's all about growth. Partnering with top-notch brands in the exciting worlds of iGaming and sports, we're on a mission to connect sports fans to global advertisers. SEO is our bread and butter, and we're relentless in our pursuit of getting our websites to the top of search results for all the best—and sometimes toughest—keywords.

With bases in both France and Brazil, we're making waves across 20+ markets. And here's the best part: we're a 100% remote team that thrives on efficiency and flexibility. So if you're ready to join a company that's all about results and values your work-life balance, we'd love to hear from you!

Our approach

We focus on people. We put end users' experience as a priority on all strategies and processes. Thus, we aim to make complex topics easy to understand and provide exactly what our audience is seeking. We achieve this by carefully analyzing data and reflecting upon it, writing the content with care, and ensuring a smooth user experience.

Here at MoveUp Media, we believe in the power of diversity and inclusion. We are committed to providing equal opportunities for all individuals, regardless of their background, race, gender, sexual orientation, or abilities. We celebrate the unique perspectives and talents that each person brings to the table, and we strive to create a welcoming and supportive environment where everyone can thrive and succeed. We firmly believe that a diverse workforce leads to greater teamwork and success. Join us in our journey towards a more inclusive and equitable future! title: Founding Qa / Test Automation Engineer (Full Stack, Ai + Data Systems)
description:
Job Description

We're a stealth startup backed by a repeat founder and top-tier investors.

We're rebuilding the financial plumbing behind a trillion-dollar asset class — commercial real estate insurance — one of the largest, most archaic financial systems in the United States.

Today, this market still runs on manual workflows, fragmented data, and decades-old infrastructure.

Our top competitors represent over $300B in combined market value, and the core workflows in this industry have not been meaningfully disrupted in decades.

We're building an AI-native platform that ingests fragmented insurance data across documents, APIs, and third-party systems, and transforms it into a unified, structured layer for underwriting and decision-making.

Incubated by a team that has already built two successful companies in this exact industry and ICP, we're now assembling a world-class team to build the next one.

We are assembling the Avengers of financial services and insurance tech — a small, elite team of builders who want to define this category.

We're looking for a Founding QA / Test Automation Engineer to ensure every data point we produce is correct, reliable, and production-ready.

This is not traditional QA. This is owning quality across AI systems, data pipelines, and critical financial infrastructure — where silent failures are unacceptable.

The Role

As the Founding QA / Test Automation Engineer, you will:

- Own testing across the full stack — frontend, backend, and AI/ML outputs

- Build testing infrastructure and CI/CD pipelines from scratch

- Design regression frameworks to detect accuracy drift across model and prompt changes

- Validate complex data pipelines where correctness is non-negotiable

- Define and enforce quality standards across deterministic systems and AI/ML outputs

- Work directly with founders and engineers to ship quickly without compromising quality

- Set the bar for all future QA and engineering hires

What You'll Own

- End-to-end validation of data and document processing systems from ingestion through structured output

- Regression frameworks to ensure accuracy and consistency across evolving AI/ML systems

- API integration testing and validation of external data flows

- Frontend critical user flows across core product experiences

- CI/CD pipelines and automated quality gates across the stack

- Monitoring and alerting for production systems to ensure reliability at scale

Who Are You?

- You've tested systems where correctness actually matters (financial data, insurance, data infrastructure, or document processing)

- Experience at high-growth startups where speed and quality both matter

- You understand how to validate data pipelines and AI/ML outputs — not just web apps

- You've built or want to build automated testing frameworks from scratch

- Comfortable operating across backend systems, APIs, and frontend applications

- Highly technical, AI-native, and systems-oriented

- Relentless attention to detail — you catch what others miss

Technical Skills

- Python (pytest or similar)

- Playwright or Cypress

- CI/CD (GitHub Actions or similar)

- Experience testing APIs, data pipelines, and distributed systems

Bonus:

- Experience testing LLM or AI systems

- Experience building regression or evaluation frameworks

- Experience with document processing or OCR systems

- Experience working in insurance or insurtech environments

Culture & Expectations

This is an intense, output-driven environment.

We operate at high velocity with a small team of exceptional builders.

We operate on a 9-9-6 cadence — because rebuilding an industry demands it.

High ownership. High accountability. High standards.

We don't care about pedigree, background, or years of experience. We care about ability.

We are looking for the top 0.0001% — people who take pride in building systems that must work.

Logistics

- Quarterly trips to NYC for collaboration

Compensation

Competitive salary

Meaningful equity

Leadership path fully uncapped for the right person

Who This Is Ideal For

A QA / Test Automation engineer who has operated as a founding or early QA hire (#1/#2) at a high-growth startup, or someone who has built and scaled testing infrastructure in fast-moving environments. You should genuinely believe you are the strongest QA engineers in any room and want the opportunity to own quality end-to-end — from building the testing foundation to shaping how an entire engineering organization thinks about correctness and reliability.

Why Join Now?

You'd be joining at the exact moment when:

- The company is fully incubated and de-risked by proven founders

- Two successful companies have already been built in this domain

- The wedge is validated, pipeline active, customers already aligned

- The market is at a breaking point and demanding change

- The next 18 months will define a multi-billion-dollar outcome

If you're hungry, relentless, and want to help rearchitect a trillion-dollar market — reach out. There aren't many chances to be this early on something this big.

A SOMOS Educação é um dos principais grupos de educação básica do Brasil, oferecendo uma ampla variedade de soluções educacionais. Nossos serviços incluem sistemas de ensino, editoras, soluções de ensino complementares e uma plataforma tecnológica de aprendizado digital e e-commerce. Com isso, nos apresentamos como parceiros integrais das escolas.

Entre as marcas que compõem o nosso grupo estão Anglo, PH, Plurall, Líder em Mim e outras. Nossa missão é transformar o ecossistema das escolas privadas, combinando educação e gestão de alta qualidade com base na neurociência e na tecnologia em larga escala. Além disso, buscamos liderar as escolas no processo de transformação digital, visando ser o principal agente de reinvenção da educação para o aluno e a escola do século XXI.

Para cumprir essa missão e entregar o melhor para as nossas escolas, baseamos nosso trabalho em valores fundamentais. Valorizamos a autonomia e o apoio, o bem-estar, a excelência, a liderança e a inovação em nossa rotina de trabalho. Somos o único grupo educacional classificado como uma das Melhores Empresas para se trabalhar, Great Place to Work – GPTW.

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

- Coordenar a equipe de tecnologia, garantindo a qualidade e integridade das informações;

- Realizar análise de dados, utilizando técnicas de Business Intelligence e Data Mining;

- Gerenciar o banco de dados e implementar soluções de Big Data;

- Liderar projetos de análise de dados e extração de insights;

- Resolver problemas relacionados à manipulação e interpretação de dados;

- Promover a comunicação eficaz entre a equipe e demais áreas da empresa.

Requisitos e qualificações:

- Graduação em Ciência da Computação

- Pós-graduação em Análise de Dados

- Certificação em Big Data

- Experiência comprovada em análise de dados e gestão de equipes

- Conhecimento em estatística e técnicas de Machine Learning

- Habilidade de liderança, trabalho em equipe e adaptabilidade

- Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e resolução de problemas

O que você pode esperar da gente?

  • Participação nos lucros: resultados com comemoração fazem parte do jeito Cogna.
  • Vale-refeição ou alimentação: num cartão de benefícios flexível.
  • Assistência médica: um abrangente plano de saúde, com inclusão de dependentes e coparticipação.
  • Assistência odontológica: está disponível para manter seu sorriso.

Mas espera, ainda tem mais!

  • Bolsas de estudo de graduação e pós graduação: nossas unidades de ensino para que você e seus dependentes (cônjuge e filhos).
  • Day off no aniversário: você poderá escolher um dia para relaxar e celebrar.
  • Convênio farmácia Univers: descontos numa variedade de medicamentos.
  • Universidade corporativa: diversas trilhas e cursos gratuitos na nossa universidade corporativa para você seguir evoluindo com a gente.
  • Descontos em livros: para você adquirir os melhores títulos em nossas editoras.
  • Wellhub (Gympass): para que você possa se movimentar no seu dia a dia.
  • Conexa: Atendimento psicológico gratuito para cuidar da sua saúde mental.
  • Programa Ninho: Um programa dedicado às nossas famílias que estão aguardando um novo bebê.
  • Valoriza - Programa de Recrutamento Interno: Para impulsionar sua carreira por meio de oportunidades internas.

Aqui, acreditamos no respeito, na diversidade e na busca da inclusão em todas suas frentes. Todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados independentemente de raça, gênero, identidade, expressão de gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, genética, deficiência ou de qualquer outra base.

Nosso propósito é avançar cada vez mais, gerando empregabilidade para talentos diversos. Venha enriquecer nosso time!

title: Brand & Copy Strategist
description:
Hey, Dingus!

Yep—you read that right. Dingus & Zazzy is expanding, and we're on the hunt for a Brand & Copy Strategist!

About Us

Dingus & Zazzy is a global digital marketing agency helping brands grow across every corner of the digital landscape. We offer an "unlimited get-shit-done" subscription for our clients—from websites to social to SEO and everything in between.

Our team is full of creatives, strategists, tech geeks, and builders who love making brands look, feel, and perform better online. If that sounds like your vibe, keep reading.

Purpose of This Position

As a Brand & Copy Strategist, you are responsible for writing and owning all copy for the clients within your squad, ensuring that every word reflects the brand's voice, positioning, and intent.

You ensure that every piece of written content across websites, social media, email, and campaigns is on-brand, intentional, and delivered at a high standard. You bring together copywriting, brand awareness, practical content direction, strategy, and project management to ensure brands are represented clearly and consistently through words.

You act as the bridge between brand intent and execution, translating client goals and direction into clear, purposeful copy that is ready for internal review and client delivery.

Core Responsibility

Serve as the owner of brand representation through copy for your squad's clients. Your accountability is defined by the following questions:

  • "Is this copy clear, on-brand, purposeful, and strong enough to confidently move forward?"
  • \ "Is this project timeline possible with the resources we have for proper execution?"

Main Objectives

1. Content Execution & Copywriting

  • Write high-quality, purpose-driven copy for:
  • -Websites
  • -Social media captions and post copy
  • -Email campaigns
  • -Campaign and promotional assets
  • Design-related copy (headlines, CTAs, supporting text)
  • Act as the primary writer for all copy deliverables within your squad.
  • Ensure every piece of copy is written with intention, clarity, and audience awareness.
  • Perform copyediting on your own work to maintain consistency, grammatical excellence, and brand alignment, using tools and peers as needed.

2. Strategy & Project Management

  • Create social media strategies for your clients based on their goals and audiences
  • Keep track of client feedback and apply them to future work
  • Plan content in batches for the month, ensuring:
  • -Consistency in writing style
  • -Variety in content types
  • -A range of related, engaging topics

3. Social Media Copy & Content Direction

  • Develop and write social media copy that reflects the brand's voice and messaging.
  • When appropriate, define content themes and messaging direction for social platforms.
  • When deeper strategy or clarity is required, collaborate with Special Teams to receive social content strategy support or plans.
  • Execute all social media copy in alignment with the strategy you create and flag any gaps or unclear direction early.

4. Creative Collaboration & Brand Consistency

  • Participate in brainstorming and ideation sessions to help define the content, messaging, and assets required for campaigns and initiatives.
  • Provide copy-led input on creative direction to ensure consistency of brand voice, messaging, and intent across all touchpoints.
  • Collaborate with designers, Marketing Coordinators, and Account Managers to align written and visual assets under a cohesive brand narrative.
  • Contribute perspective beyond copy when needed to maintain brand clarity and consistency.

5. Brand Advocacy

  • Act as the copy owner for each assigned brand, ensuring consistent voice, tone, and messaging across all written content.
  • Apply brand guidelines and positioning directly within copy execution.
  • Review copy deliverables to ensure they meet internal quality standards and accurately represent the brand's intent.

Reporting Relationship

  • This role reports to the designated Account Manager of your squad.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

1. Brand Alignment & Copy Effectiveness

  • Ensure all copy deliverables are consistently aligned with the brand's voice, tone, and messaging.
  • Maintain minimal client revisions related to brand alignment, tone, or clarity.
  • Contribute social content ideas and messaging angles when needed, ensuring alignment with the brand's voice, positioning, and goals.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to ensure brand consistency across copy and supporting assets.

2. Content Quality & Accuracy

  • Deliver copy that meets internal quality standards for clarity, structure, and purpose.
  • Maintain a low rate of client dissatisfaction related to copy quality or intent.

3. Project Delivery Timeliness

  • Deliver copy-related tasks within agreed timelines.
  • Collaborate with the squad to support smooth handoffs and on-time delivery of content assets.

Work Details

  • Hours: 9 A.M. – 5 P.M. MST, Monday to Friday
  • Requires a working level of written and spoken English

Ready for the ride of your life? Apply now!

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
About Magentrix

Magentrix is a PRM (Partner Relationship Management) SaaS platform that helps companies scale with partners. We power secure partner portals that drive adoption, collaboration, and revenue. Our customers span software, manufacturing, and services;
our team values ownership, curiosity, and measurable outcomes.

Role Overview

We're hiring a Customer Success Manager based in Brazil to own a portfolio of international customers. Your focus is on outcomes such as retention, expansion, adoption, and advocacy. You'll work with leadership to set clear goals and co-create practical plans (onboarding/time-to-value, adoption plans, save plans). You will act as a solution engineer, translating business problems and use cases into pragmatic portal solutions that deliver measurable value. You'll have autonomy to try approaches that work for your customers and regular coaching to help you make it happen.

What You'll Do

· Own a customer book and deliver on GRR, NRR, adoption, and NPS targets

· Co-create and run onboarding/time-to-value and adoption plans using templates, playbooks, and your ideas, iterate using data and customer feedback

· Lead EBRs, multi-thread stakeholders, and manage renewals/expansions with clear next steps

· Monitor health signals and usage, identify risks early and execute save plans

· Lead discovery to understand business use cases and pain points, design portal configurations and workflows that solve them, and clearly document and present the solution to customers

· Translate business goals into clear requirements and coordinate with Support, Product, and Services

· Capture learnings, improve playbooks, and contribute voice-of-customer insights to the roadmap

Requirements (Must-Haves)

· Fluent English (written and spoken);
confident facilitating executive meetings and EBRs

· 5+ years in SaaS Customer Success or adjacent roles (consulting, account management, product enablement) with measurable renewal/adoption results

· Solution engineering capability in a SaaS environment, able to run discovery, map requirements to portal capabilities, design configurations and workflows, explain trade offs, and handle live product Q&A with customers

· You've contributed to or improved an onboarding/TTV plan, save play, or EBR narrative

· Comfort balancing autonomy and coaching, able to propose approaches, accept feedback, and refine quickly

· Strong stakeholder management and clear written communication

· Analytical skills (spreadsheets/BI) to interpret product usage, set KPIs, and make data-backed decisions

· Familiarity with PRM/CRM concepts (partner onboarding, deal registration, content/enablement workflows)

Preferred Qualifications

· Experience with PRM, CRM, or portal products (e.G., Salesforce, HubSpot)

· Exposure to global SaaS motions (serving North America/EMEA)

· Technically self-sufficient in a SaaS environment, able to run live module demos, handle product Q&A, and perform light configuration or troubleshooting during customer calls

· Working grasp of web and SaaS fundamentals, for example HTTP and JSON basics, user roles and permissions, data mapping, environments

· Conceptual understanding of SSO standards such as SAML or OIDC

· Comfort mapping data between PRM and CRM, managing CSV imports and exports, and validating data quality during onboarding and expansion

· Ability to translate business goals into configurations or clear technical tickets and partner effectively with Support and Product

Location & Working Hours

· Brazil-based (fully remote)

· Full overlap with Eastern Time (ET) working hours

What We Offer

· Market-aligned compensation with outcome-based variable tied to GRR/NRR

· Clear goals, regular coaching, and a path to increased scope based on results

· Autonomy within established guardrails to test approaches and iterate with data

· High visibility with leadership and direct impact on customer outcomes

· Structured feedback, documented playbooks, and opportunities to present learnings

How to Apply

Submit your CV in English, and one paragraph describing how you would approach the first 60 days after a new client's go-live in a PRM or partner-portal context, include your assumptions, your definition of time-to-first-value, the key milestones you would drive, and how you would measure progress.

title: Manager, Corporate Development - M&A Origination & Deal Sourcing
description:
Gemini Group (csigemini.Com) is part of Constellation Software Inc. (TSX: CSU), a global acquirer, builder, and manager of vertical market software businesses. Gemini partners with high-quality software companies, providing long-term operational support, capital, and strategic guidance to help them grow sustainably. Our portfolio spans multiple vertical markets and operates through decentralized business units that are deeply embedded in their respective industries. Learn more here: csigemini.Com

The Role

The Manager, Corporate Development will play a critical role in identifying, building, and nurturing strategic relationships that lead to new acquisition opportunities for Gemini Group.

In this role, you will engage with software company leaders. Your success will be measured by your ability to cultivate meaningful, trust-based relationships that ultimately result in Gemini acquiring high-quality software businesses. Relationship-building in this role is a long-term endeavor - often taking multiple years from first contact to acquisition. Success requires persistence, strategic thinking, disciplined pipeline management, high-quality market research, and a consistent ability to add value across many conversations.

As Gemini continues to expand its presence globally, this Brazil based role will also play a foundational part in helping scale Gemini's M&A capability in the LATAM market. Over time, the Manager, Corporate Development will have the opportunity to contribute to the growth of a localized M&A function - including shaping best practices and helping establish Gemini as a preferred partner for LATAM software entrepreneurs. This is a unique chance to be a builder of Gemini's deal-sourcing footprint in Brazil while advancing your own leadership trajectory within the organization.

Key Outcomes

  • Develop, manage, and expand an M&A pipeline using Salesforce CRM, including market mapping within assigned software verticals.
  • Meet and exceed weekly and quarterly sourcing and relationship-building KPIs.
  • Work both independently and in collaboration with Gemini's M&A leadership to efficiently evaluate potential acquisition opportunities.
  • Ensure accurate categorization and allocation of leads within relevant portfolio verticals.
  • Effectively screen and qualify opportunities at the top of the acquisition funnel to support Portfolio Managers and operating teams.
  • Support the long-term build-out of Gemini's LATAM/Brazil M&A presence by contributing to sourcing processes, knowledge sharing, and future team development.
  • Engage directly with founders, CEOs, and controlling shareholders, conducting high-quality M&A conversations to understand ownership dynamics, M&A insights, motivations, business insights and timing of a future, potential deal.
  • Qualify opportunities through initial commercial, operational, and financial assessment, filtering deals before internal escalation.
  • Coordinate internally with global teams (Perseus / CSI) to align on pipeline prioritization and strategic fit.
  • Maintain structured tracking of interactions and insights (CRM-driven), ensuring continuity and depth of relationship over time.

Relevant Experience & Competencies

  • At least three years of experience in M&A business development, with proven involvement in various aspects of M&A such as mandate origination (including private equity), initial contact with key decision-makers, deal negotiation, or client-facing roles in M&A or finance within the software or technology sector.
  • Experience in outbound deal origination planning.
  • Previous exposure on relationship-building meetings (virtual or in-person) with company owners to explore strategic M&A opportunities.
  • Demonstrated interest in building a long-term career in software investing, M&A, or corporate development.
  • Track record of high performance in business development, entrepreneurship, or other competitive environments.
  • Strong executive presence with the ability to confidently engage senior leaders, including CEOs, investors, and advisors.
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable working autonomously.
  • Self-motivated, proactive, and results-driven with a strong sense of urgency.

Other Requirements

  • Willingness to travel occasionally within Brazil and broader LATAM as well as internationally to Canada, the U.S., and Portugal.
  • Professional working proficiency in both English and Portuguese is required.
  • Professional working proficiency in Spanish is a bonus.

title: English Teacher
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.

If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you're looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we've got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.

What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!

In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:

  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.

Minimum Requirements:

  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.

Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

Estamos buscando uma pessoa que irá atuar como Staff-level Engineer para projetar e gerenciar uma camada de orquestração de IA incorporada em nossos pipelines de CI/CD, transformando a IA em uma capacidade de engenharia de software controlada e escalável.

title: Senior Carrier Business Development Executive
description:
China Mobile International Limited (CMI) is a wholly-owned subsidiary of China Mobile. In order to provide better services to meet the growing demand in the international telecommunications market, China Mobile established CMI in December 2010, headquartered in Hong Kong, China. CMI has expanded its footprint in 39 countries and regions.

Leveraging the strong support by China Mobile, CMI is a trusted partner that provides comprehensive international information services and solutions to international enterprises, carriers and mobile users.

We are looking for a dynamic and proactive Senior Carrier Business Development Executive to join our team.

This role is responsible for driving business growth through new customer acquisition, account management, and strategic carrier partnerships across Voice, A2P messaging, and eSIM mobility products. The position plays a critical role in expanding market penetration, optimizing commercial conditions, and ensuring smooth operational execution in close collaboration with internal, regional, and HQ teams.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Establish, develop, and expand business relationships with customers and partners across Voice, A2P and/or eSIM mobility products, driving new revenue opportunities and account growth.
  • Define and execute sales and business development strategies, managing a structured sales pipeline by customer account and region to achieve revenue and market penetration targets.

  • Develop and manage strategic relationships with global Voice, A2P, and mobile carriers, leading negotiations to secure competitive pricing, routing, capacity, and commercial terms.
  • Lead carrier and customer contract execution, including onboarding, implementation, performance monitoring, and renewals.
  • Monitor market trends, customer needs, and carrier performance to identify growth, optimization, and partnership opportunities.
  • Support the optimization of Voice, A2P and/or eSIM mobility supply networks, ensuring service continuity, cost efficiency, and scalability.
  • Work closely with internal commercial, technical, and operational teams to ensure smooth end-to-end execution from opportunity identification to service activation.
  • Collaborate with HQ and regional teams to align on sales targets, partnership strategies, and overall business performance.

Preferred Requirements:

title: Clinical Trial Associate Ii
description:
Clinical Trial Associate II

Resumo da Posição

O Clinical Trial Associate II desempenha um papel fundamental de suporte no planejamento, execução e encerramento de estudos clínicos nacionais e internacionais, com crescente autonomia e independência operacional. Com base em experiências prévias em operações de estudos clínicos, espera-se que o CTA II gerencie proativamente a documentação e os processos principais, identifique e resolva desafios operacionais, e atue como um ponto de coordenação confiável entre as equipes de estudo, fornecedores e centros de pesquisa. Este cargo também contribui para melhorias de processos e apoia a equipe na preparação para auditorias e inspeções.

Principais Responsabilidades:

- Fornecer suporte operacional para a execução bem-sucedida dos estudos clínicos, do desenvolvimento do protocolo até o encerramento do estudo, em conformidade com as Boas Práticas Clínicas (GCP) e normas regulatórias internacionais.

- Gerenciar de forma independente os controles dos estudos clínicos, incluindo acompanhamento de documentos regulatórios, progresso de start-up, métricas de recrutamento, registros de faturas/pagamentos e desempenho de fornecedores, assegurando precisão, consistência e atualizações em tempo hábil.

- Coordenar reuniões de estudos clínicos (internas e externas), incluindo preparação de agendas, logística dos encontros e atas detalhadas com ações de acompanhamento.

- Apoiar a supervisão de fornecedores e CROs, acompanhando entregas, identificando lacunas ou riscos e comunicando-os preventivamente aos Clinical Trial Managers (CTMs).

- Auxiliar na preparação e submissão de documentos para Comitês de Ética/Comissões de Ética (IRB/EC) e para órgãos regulatórios, com papel ampliado na gestão de prazos e controle de qualidade.

- Realizar revisões contínuas do Trial Master File (TMF) e reconciliações;
liderar atividades de controle de qualidade de documentos com supervisão mínima e contribuir ativamente para o planejamento de prontidão para inspeções.

- Coordenar e acompanhar a logística de equipamentos e suprimentos dos estudos clínicos junto a fornecedores e centros.

- Colaborar com CTMs e demais áreas para promover melhorias contínuas de processos e contribuir para atualizações de Procedimentos Operacionais Padrão (SOP) e instruções de trabalho.

title: It Risk Management Lead
description:
IT Risk Management Lead

Comcentia is seeking an experienced IT Risk Management Lead to drive the design, build‐out, and continuous improvement of our client's enterprise IT Risk Management Program. This role leads the development of risk intake processes, assessment methodologies, and quantitative models aligned with NIST‐based frameworks and the organization's ISMS.

You'll partner with Cybersecurity, IT, business stakeholders, and risk owners to identify, assess, document, and monitor technology risks across the enterprise. The Lead serves as the primary SME for IT risk, producing executive‐ready reporting, maturing risk metrics and dashboards, and ensuring treatment plans are well‐defined, tracked, and executed.

Key Responsibilities:

- Lead structured IT risk assessments and apply quantitative scoring models

- Enhance risk intake processes, assessment tools, and framework alignment

- Maintain the enterprise risk register and map risks to SCF‐aligned controls

- Drive treatment planning, cross‐functional coordination, and lifecycle tracking

- Deliver risk reporting, dashboards, and decision‐ready materials for leadership

- Support governance cycles, audit readiness, and GRC tooling adoption

- Champion automation and AI‐enabled workflows to improve program efficiency

Qualifications:

- 7+ years in IT Risk Management, ISMS, or Cybersecurity

- Strong English proficiency (TOEFL Score: 90+) required

- Experience leading enterprise risk programs—not just contributing to them

- Strong knowledge of ISO 27001, NIST CSF, SOC 2, PCI, GDPR

- Hands‐on experience with GRC platforms and risk assessment methodologies

- Excellent communication skills for both technical and executive audiences

- Preferred certifications: ISO 27001 Lead Implementer/Auditor, CISA, CISSP, CISM, SCF Practitioner

Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?

Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.

  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.

O diferencial?

Aqui você é mais que um professor.

Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas, onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.

Esta não é uma vaga CLT, mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.

Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.

Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.

Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!

O que eu faço?

Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.

QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?

Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.

title: Visual & Brand Experience Designer
description:
Visual & Brand Experience Designer

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Visual & Brand Experience Designer to support a large-scale digital product initiative focused on modernizing the user experience of a leading marketplace platform. This role will play a key part in reimagining how customers navigate and interact with a multi-brand digital ecosystem.

You will lead the Visual Makeover & Usability workstream while also helping shape a multi-brand gallery experience that brings together multiple brands within a single marketplace environment. The ideal candidate is a highly creative product designer who can quickly move from research and benchmarking into compelling visual concepts that inspire stakeholders and guide product direction.

This is a fast-paced consulting environment with short delivery cycles, so comfort working in ambiguous environments and presenting bold ideas to senior stakeholders is essential.

What You'll Do

  • Design and lead the visual direction for key product workstreams focused on improving usability and modernizing the marketplace interface.
  • Conduct benchmarking of leading global marketplace platforms to inform design strategy and identify best-in-class user experience patterns.
  • Develop high-fidelity visual concepts and exploratory prototypes that communicate new interface directions and inspire product leadership.
  • Design and prototype a multi-brand navigation and discovery experience that enables users to seamlessly browse across brands within a unified marketplace.
  • Collaborate closely with product managers, engineers, and stakeholders to translate design ideas into clear product directions.
  • Present design concepts and rationale to senior stakeholders, helping guide decision-making around product experience and visual identity.
  • Work within a fast-moving consulting team delivering iterative design outputs across short delivery cycles.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in product design, visual design, or UI design
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating high-quality interface design and visual storytelling
  • Deep understanding of e-commerce and marketplace design patterns
  • Experience analyzing and benchmarking international digital products
  • Ability to produce high-fidelity concepts and exploratory prototypes that communicate bold design ideas
  • Comfort presenting conceptual work to senior leadership and stakeholders
  • Fluency in Portuguese (required working language)
  • Ability to thrive in fast-paced consulting environments with rapid iteration cycles

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience designing multi-brand digital ecosystems or marketplaces
  • Familiarity with Asian marketplace and super-app UX paradigms such as those seen in Alibaba, Shopee, or Pinduoduo
  • Background working with retail, consumer products, or marketplace platforms
  • Previous experience in agency or consulting environments with fast delivery timelines

If you're a designer who enjoys pushing visual boundaries, exploring global product patterns, and shaping the experience of large-scale digital platforms, this role offers the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on a high-visibility product initiative.

title: Software Engineer
description:
Role Overview

We are looking for a hands‐on Software Engineer to join the Developer Risk (DevRisk) team. You will build data-driven features and services that power developer review and enforcement workflows. The role spans querying large datasets, building back-end services and front-end review UI components, and implementing platform capabilities that improve risk detection and decision-making.

You will collaborate closely with data engineers, product managers, and reviewers to translate business criteria into robust tooling and dashboards, ensuring accuracy, performance, and end‐to‐end reliability.

Key Responsibilities

  • Data Querying & Reporting: Write efficient SQL queries to extract data from the DevRisk Data Warehouse and populate dashboards/spreadsheets to deliver required statistics and insights.
  • Policy & Criteria Improvements: Identify improvements to developer ban criteria based on data analysis and implement corresponding changes in DevRisk tooling and review UI.
  • Frontend (Review UI): Build pages and widgets in the reviewer UI to render critical information for decision-making;
    ensure usability, consistency, and performance.
  • Backend Services: Design and implement back-end services and APIs to power the review UI and related enforcement workflows.
  • Enforcement Platform: Design and implement platform functionality that enables accurate, auditable, and scalable developer enforcement.
  • Quality & Reliability: Perform end‐to‐end testing, optimization, and integration of implemented services;
    monitor performance anditerate based on feedback.
  • Documentation: Document data lineage, UI/UX behavior, and service contracts to support operability and governance.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
  • Industry experience in software engineering or closely related areas.
  • Proficiency in at least one of C++, Java, or Python.
  • Strong experience with SQL for complex querying and data manipulation.
  • Fluency in English (reading, writing, speaking, and listening).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Proficiency in Java/C++/Python and SQL (multiple languages).
  • Experience with ETL and data pipelines (batch and/or streaming).
  • Hands‐on experience with version control, collaborative code reviews, and automated testing (e.G., Git/Gerrit, CI/CD, unit/integration/e2e testing).
  • Exposure to risk, trust & safety, enforcement systems, or policy tooling is a plus.
  • Familiarity with data modeling, observability (metrics, logging, tracing), and secure coding practices.

Tech Stack (Indicative)

  • Languages: Java, Python, C++
  • Data: SQL, Data Warehouse, ETL/ELT tools, spreadsheets/dashboarding
  • Backend: REST/gRPC services, microservices, authentication/authorization
  • Frontend: Component‐based UI (widgets/pages for reviewer workflows)
  • Testing: Unit, integration, E2E;
    CI/CD pipelines
  • Ops: Monitoring, alerting, performance tuning

What We're Looking For

  • Strong problem‐solving skills and a data‐driven mindset.
  • Ability to translate policy/business requirements into technical designs.
  • Ownership across the lifecycle: design, implementation, testing, deployment, and support.
  • Excellent collaboration with cross‐functional partners and stakeholders.

Igualdade & Oportunidade para Todos

  • Representando 165 nacionalidades em todo o mundo, nos orgulhamos de ser um empregador que oferece igualdade de oportunidades, comprometido em fornecer oportunidades iguais de emprego a todos os candidatos e funcionários, independentemente de raça, religião, sexo, cor, idade, nacionalidade, gravidez, orientação sexual, deficiência física ou informações genéticas, ou qualquer outra classificação protegida, de acordo com as leis federais, estaduais e/ou locais.

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

title: Freight Desk Manager
description:
Position Scope

The Freight Desk Manager is a high-impact leadership role responsible for architecting and overseeing the logistics support function for non-finished goods on a global scale, with a dedicated focus on the LATAM region. This position operates at the intersection of global procurement and operational execution, managing a complex ecosystem of freight forwarders, control towers, and internal stakeholders. The mission is to ensure world-class shipment execution and financial integrity through robust audit structures and the expansion of logistics capabilities in high-growth markets.

Responsibilities and Accountabilities

  • Regional Strategy & Expansion: Serve as the primary architect for logistics operations in LATAM, including the enablement of Importer of Record (IOR) operations and regional supplier onboarding.
  • Global Freight Desk Leadership: Lead the logistics support function for specialized shipments, managing a network of global freight forwarders operating through dedicated control towers.
  • Rate Card Governance: Standardize and maintain global Bulk Air and Ocean rate cards across a diverse portfolio of international suppliers to ensure cost consistency and transparency.
  • Strategic Sourcing: Lead RFQs and supplier onboarding initiatives for logistics, ensuring all partners meet global compliance and service level standards.
  • Governance & Audit Architecture: Design and maintain a global freight audit strategy and control architecture to ensure financial discipline across high-volume global invoice environments.
  • Control Tower Oversight: Drive operational excellence by governing forwarder performance, ensuring industry-leading on-time shipment execution across all transport modes.
  • Automation & Process Engineering: Implement automated invoice approval systems and systemic controls to improve first-pass yield and overall operational efficiency.
  • Stakeholder Management: Partner with global cross-functional teams to support non-standard logistics requirements and rapid-response delivery programs.

Mandatory Requirements

  • Experience: Extensive experience in Global Supply Management, Logistics Procurement, or Supply Chain Operations within multinational environments.
  • Regional Expertise: Deep knowledge of the LATAM logistics landscape, including regulatory requirements, customs, and supplier networks.
  • Procurement Mastery: Proven track record in leading RFQs and managing complex logistics supplier onboarding processes.
  • Network Management: Experience managing large-scale global freight forwarder relationships and\ "Control Tower\" operational models.
  • Technical Proficiency: Strong background in Logistics Financial Control (Freight Audit) and managing high-volume, global-scale invoice environments.
  • Leadership: Experience leading international teams and managing external providers across different time zones (APAC, EMEA, AMR).
  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, International Trade, or a related field.
  • Languages: Fluency in English is essential for regional and global coordination.

Desirable Requirements

  • Advanced Education: MBA or Master's degree.
  • Process Excellence: Certifications in Lean Six Sigma or similar experience.
  • Digital Transformation: Experience implementing AI-driven or automated financial auditing and rate management tools.
  • Rapid Growth Background: Experience managing logistics for hyper-growth programs (e.G., international express expansions or specialized delivery models).

title: Finance Manager
description:
About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.

Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.

As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.

Key Responsibilities

  • Oversee daily liquidity positioning in both BRL and digital assets, ensuring the firm meets all operational and regulatory obligations.
  • Maintain rigorous oversight of treasury-related accounting entries, ensuring accuracy in the general ledger and alignment with local Brazilian accounting standards.
  • Maintain accounting practices in strict accordance with the Accounting Standard for Institutions Regulated by the Central Bank of Brazil (COSIF), ensuring all financial statements are audit-ready.
  • Lead the preparation and timely submission of CADOC (Central Bank of Brazil Data Collection) reports, ensuring all financial data transmitted to regulators is accurate and consistent.
  • Implement and monitor ACAM frameworks to ensure the Brazilian entity remains within the risk appetite defined by the Central Bank and global HQ.
  • Develop and execute strategies to minimize idle cash, manage currency exposure (FX), and optimize transaction costs across local banking partners.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for local banking partners and regulatory bodies regarding treasury operations, audits, and financial inquiries.
  • Monitor market volatility and counterparty risk, implementing hedging strategies where necessary to protect the firm's balance sheet.

Requirements

  • Experience: Minimum of 5–7 years of experience in Treasury, Corporate Finance, or Financial Operations, preferably within a Fintech, Bank, or Crypto-related institution.
  • Technical Knowledge: Deep understanding of Central Bank of Brazil (BCB) regulations.
  • Hands-on experience with CADOC reporting and ACAM risk management guidelines.
  • Strong background in Accounting (IFRS/CPC) and financial statement analysis.
  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Economics, Finance, or a related field. Professional certifications (e.G., CRC, CFA, or specialized Treasury certifications) are a significant plus.
  • Language Skills: Fluency in English and Portuguese is mandatory, as you will collaborate with global teams and local regulators.
  • Crypto Proficiency: Familiarity with blockchain technology, wallet management, including understanding of blockchain custody, proof of reserves methodologies, and the specific dynamics of the VASP market in Brazil.

O DESAFIO:

  • Monitoramento de Performance: Utilizar ferramentas como Langfuse ou LangSmith para monitorar latência, consumo de tokens e qualidade das respostas em tempo real.
  • Desenvolvimento de Ferramentas: Criar conexões seguras entre LLMs e APIs externas via Model Context Protocol (MCP), garantindo o isolamento e a segurança dos dados.
  • Arquitetura RAG: Otimizar pipelines de recuperação de informação utilizando Vector Stores (Pinecone ou MongoDB) para mitigar alucinações e aumentar a precisão contextual.
  • Infraestrutura Cloud: Gerenciar deploys em ambientes AWS ou Azure e integrar modelos via AWS Bedrock ou Azure OpenAI Service, priorizando arquiteturas Serverless e Event-Driven.
  • AI Guardrails: Implementar camadas de filtragem e validação de prompts/outputs para evitar injeções de código ou desvios éticos.
  • Avaliação Sistemática: Desenvolver frameworks de testes (Evals) para validar a eficácia de novas funcionalidades antes do deploy em produção.
  • Eficiência de Custos: Monitorar e otimizar o uso de modelos (Model Routing) para equilibrar performance e custo operacional.

O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA:

  • Linguagens: Domínio avançado de Python e Java para automação de workflows e integraçoes e desenvolvimento de IA.

Strong experience with SIEM platforms (e.G.,Sentinel).

Excellent communication skills and ability to work in cross-functional

title: Desenvolvedor(A) Java Sênior
description:
Quem somos nós?

Somos um ecossistema de transformação digital que combina tecnologia e visão estratégica para escalar resultados e aumentar o valor entregue aos nossos clientes. Trabalhamos na construção de soluções inovadoras e disruptivas em mais de 300 projetos com grandes empresas nacionais de múltiplos segmentos.

Nosso propósito é impactar positivamente pessoas e negócios, exponencializando cada um para atingir seu máximo potencial. Respeitamos todas as diferenças e criamos um espaço aberto e livre para você ter autonomia, expor suas ideias, aprender com os erros, se conectar com outras pessoas e gerar mudanças ao seu redor.

Se você deseja estar em um ambiente colaborativo, desafiador e que incentiva você a sempre evoluir e ser o protagonista da sua história, aqui é o seu lugar!

Antes de avançarmos, é importante você saber que:

  • Contratação: CLT
  • Modelo de Trabalho: Remoto
  • Horário: das 9h às 12h e das 13h às 18h. A jornada é flexível conforme agendas e entregas. .
  • Etapas do Processo: Composto por 3 a 4 etapas, com um tempo médio de até 03 dias úteis entre uma etapa e outra.
  • Meios de Comunicação: Utilizamos E-mail e WhatsApp. Certifique-se de que essas informações estejam corretas no momento de inscrição para evitar falhas na comunicação.

O que buscamos?

Estamos em busca de um/uma Desenvolvedor(a) Backend Java Sênior para fazer parte do nosso movimento. Quem ocupar esta posição será responsável por implementar e orquestrar microsserviços modernos, arquiteturas orientadas a eventos (Kafka/RabbitMQ) assumindo entregas de ponta a ponta, da implementação ao deploy em produção. Esperamos que você encabece integrações complexas, atue no tuning avançado das aplicações e suas integrações com bancos de dados (SQL/NoSQL) e seja protagonista na adoção de tecnologias emergentes, além de criar ambientes de confiança para revisões de código de alto padrão.

Como será seu dia-a-dia?

  • Implementar e evoluir arquiteturas de aplicações de microsserviços e sistemas orientados a eventos, garantindo escalabilidade, resiliência e manutenibilidade ao longo do tempo;
  • Elaborar templates de arquitetura de aplicação de referência para o time, sempre que demandado;
  • Protagonizar decisões técnicas com visão de impacto, explicitando trade-offs para o time e para produto, mesmo em cenários com informações incompletas;
  • Garantir a estabilidade dos sistemas em produção, realizando a resposta a incidentes, definindo prioridades de correção e propondo melhorias estruturais para evitar recorrência;
  • Implementar e disseminar práticas de observabilidade (OpenTelemetry, APM com Datadog/NewRelic/Dynatrace) e tracing distribuído para aumentar a previsibilidade operacional;
  • Conduzir code reviews de alto padrão, orientando o time em boas práticas de arquitetura, design patterns, testes e segurança;
  • Atuar em integrações complexas com sistemas internos e externos, aplicando padrões de resiliência como Circuit Breaker, Retry, Fallback e SAGA;
  • Identificar gargalos e oportunidades de melhoria em queries SQL, estratégias de cache e configurações de pool de conexões para otimizar a performance das aplicações;
  • Apoiar diretamente líderes técnicos (Tech Leads) em acordos técnicos entre squad, produto e demais áreas, traduzindo complexidade técnica em impacto de negócio de forma clara e rastreável;
  • Explorar e adotar tecnologias emergentes de forma responsável, avaliando custo, benefício e risco antes da incorporação no stack do time.
  • Aprimorar continuamente os processos e práticas de desenvolvimento, aplicando técnicas de uso de Inteligência Artificial para otimizar o desenvolvimento de software, de forma avançada e responsável.

Para cumprir esse desafio, você precisa ter:

  • Profundidade em Java avançado: Multithread, gerenciamento de memória/GC, Virtual Threads (Java 21) e domínio das diferenças entre versões LTS, bem como domínio total de programação funcional;
  • Domínio amplo de Design Patterns com capacidade de reconhecer o momento certo de aplicá-los;
    entendimento de como a Injeção de Dependência funciona internamente (Reflection/Proxies);
  • Experiência sólida com Spring (Boot, Data, Security) e uso de frameworks reativos;
  • Domínio de estratégias de resiliência em integrações: Circuit Breaker, Retry, Fallback e SAGA (ex: Resilience4j);
    domínio do conceito de Idempotência;
  • Experiência prática e profunda com Kafka (Partições, Offsets, Consumer Groups) e RabbitMQ avançado (DLQ, Retry Policies, Exchanges);
  • Capacidade de realizar tuning de queries SQL, criação de índices, e estratégias de cache (local vs distribuído, TTL e invalidação);
  • Domínio avançado de pelo menos um banco de dados relacional e um banco NoSQL (MongoDB ou DynamoDB);
  • Domínio de observabilidade avançada com OpenTelemetry, pelo menos uma ferramenta de APM (Datadog/NewRelic/Dynatrace) e tracing distribuído;
  • Experiência prática com Kubernetes. Não irá administrar diretamente, mas é necessária experiência de interpretação do ecossistema;
  • Experiência prática com componentes de pelo menos uma Cloud (AWS ou GCP)
  • Capacidade real e experiência em Documentação como código usando Mermaid ou PlantUML através de arquivos markdown;
  • Domínio sólido de estratégias em pelo menos uma ferramenta de IA assistida (GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Antigravity ou Claude Code), bem como experiência prática de consumo de pelo menos 1 tipo de MCP Server através destas ferramentas.

Você irá se destacar se:

  • Ser committer ativo em repositórios open-source relevantes;
  • Experiência em tuning avançado de integração com bancos de dados usando JPA e pool de conexões (ex: HikariCP);
  • Ter realizado publicações técnicas em canais relevantes (blog, artigos, palestras, conferências);
  • Experiência comframeworks como Apache Camel ou outros de integração de sistemas (ESB/EDA);
  • Experiência em arquitetura orientada a eventos (EDA) de alta complexidade;
  • Conhecimento ouexperiência com bancos de dados colunares ou baseados em grafos;
  • Certificações Cloud (AWS ou GCP) ativas;
  • Implementação de API Gateways (Kong, Sensedia, AWS API Gateway) via configuração e/ou código;
  • Experiência em integração arquitetural de APIs de LLM (LangChain, RAG/bancos vetoriais) ou criação de soluções próprias baseadas em IA;
  • Capacidade de liderar migrações de monolitos para microsserviços;
  • Ter implementado mais de dois exemplos de servidores MCP de alta complexidade técnica.

O que oferecemos aos nossos Builders?

  • Auxílio Alimentação (VA/VR) no cartão Caju;
  • Auxílio Home-Office no cartão Caju;
  • Programa de Pontos Flexíveis em seu Caju - um valor fléxivel para você usar como você quiser;
  • Plano de Saúde Nacional Porto Seguro (Plano Prata com apartamento e sem coparticipação) com 50% da mensalidade custeada pela Builders;
  • Assistência Odontológica pela Porto Seguro (Plano Bronze) com 100% da mensalidade paga pela Builders;
  • Auxílio Creche para crianças de até 72 meses;
  • Auxílio à SaúdeMental - acesso ao aplicativo Vida+;
  • Auxílio à SaúdeFísica - acesso ao aplicativo Gympass;
  • Seguro de vida.

Todas as nossas vagas são inclusivas e abertas a pessoas de todas as identidades de gênero, orientações sexuais, idades, etnias, culturas, origens, crenças, deficiências e outras diversidades. Acreditamos que a pluralidade enriquece nosso time e promove um ambiente de trabalho mais inovador e colaborativo.

title: Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
This is mostly manual position. This role is fully remote and is a PJ contractor.

Required Skills & Experience

- 7+ years of experience in Quality Assurance (manual and/or blended QA roles) with strong ownership of test execution and release readiness.

Nice to Have Skills & Experience

- Experience testing eCommerce, booking engines, reservations, loyalty, payments, check-in/boarding, or guest service platforms.

- Exposure to test automation (any framework/tool) and ability to collaborate with automation engineers (if applicable).

- Basic SQL for validation, data checks, or troubleshooting. Experience with CI/CD pipelines and release processes.

Job Description

We are seeking a Senior QA Engineer to help ensure the quality, reliability, and performance of customer-facing and internal applications in a fast-paced travel/hospitality environment. This role will partner closely with product, engineering, and delivery teams to define test strategy, execute testing across releases, and continuously improve QA processes. The ideal candidate brings strong hands-on QA experience, deep familiarity with Jira, and working knowledge of API testing (a smaller portion of the overall workload).

Day to Day

- Own and execute end-to-end testing for web and/or mobile applications, including functional, regression, smoke, and UAT support.

- Create and maintain clear test plans, test cases, and test execution evidence aligned to release timelines.

- Work in Agile/Scrum teams to provide early QA input on requirements, acceptance criteria, and edge cases.

- Log, track, and manage defects in Jira, ensuring high-quality documentation and strong follow-through through resolution.

- Perform API validation/testing (estimated ~10% of overall effort) using tools such as Postman/Swagger or similar;
validate request/response payloads and integration behaviors.

- Collaborate with engineers and product owners to reproduce issues, validate fixes, and confirm release readiness.

- Help improve QA efficiency through better test coverage, risk-based testing, and repeatable regression approaches. Contribute to quality standards, best practices, and continuous improvement across the SDLC.

title: Desenvolvedor Servicenow | Especialista Técnico De Aplicações
description:
Descrição da Vaga (JD):

O desenvolvedor ServiceNow fará parte de uma equipe já estabelecida, apoiando a implementação do módulo Application Portfolio Management (APM) do ServiceNow. O profissional será responsável por ativar e configurar o módulo, além de trabalhar em estreita colaboração com os times funcionais para definir o escopo e os objetivos do sistema.

Como Especialista Técnico de Aplicações, você poderá esperar:

Formular e definir o escopo e os objetivos do sistema.

Ser responsável pelo design do programa, codificação, testes, depuração e documentação.

Ter conhecimento técnico e responsabilidade por todas as fases de análise e programação de sistemas de aplicações.

Compreender o negócio ou a função para a qual a aplicação está sendo projetada.

Aprender continuamente sobre novas tecnologias, gerar novas ideias e melhorar o uso de tecnologias modernas em todo o portfólio de aplicações.

Configurar e ativar o Application Portfolio Management (APM).

Desenvolver relacionamentos de Itens de Configuração (CIs) para Capacidades de Negócio, Objetos de Informação, Aplicações de Negócio e Serviços de Aplicação.

Integrar o APM com outros módulos do ServiceNow, incluindo ITSM e SAM.

Utilizar fortes competências técnicas e expertise para identificar, analisar e solucionar problemas em produção, mantendo procedimentos que atendam às expectativas dos usuários de negócio.

Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com equipes multifuncionais e times de desenvolvimento para entender e fornecer soluções/correções automatizadas.

Contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos de Delivery e Suporte, bem como para a maturidade dos diferentes portfólios, capacidades, especializações e melhores práticas, considerando as necessidades e requisitos dos usuários e stakeholders.

Participar de eventos SCRUM e concluir os itens atribuídos dentro da meta definida para a Sprint.

Reunir-se com stakeholders-chave e acompanhar os itens de ação para quaisquer soluções alternativas necessárias, de acordo com a natureza dos requisitos.

Qualificações e Requisitos

Qualificações essenciais

- Graduação ou Mestrado em Computação, Eletrônica ou área relacionada

- Certificação ServiceNow System Administrator (CSA)

- Certificação ServiceNow Certified Application Portfolio Management (APM) Implementer

- Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita, com capacidade de comunicar informações técnicas para públicos não técnicos

Competências-chave

8 a 10 anos de experiência total na área de TI

Conhecimento intermediário em linguagens de desenvolvimento: XML, HTML, CSS, Java e JavaScript

Experiência na plataforma ServiceNow como Administrador e Desenvolvedor

Experiência no desenvolvimento de Service Catalogs, implementação de ACLs, transform maps, Flows via Flow Designer, client scripts e métricas de saúde da CMDB

Configuração de Assessments, Demands, Business Capability Maps e Information Objects

Mais de 5 anos de experiência em administração ServiceNow nas seguintes áreas: Service Catalog, CMDB & Discovery, Service Portal, Workflows, Dashboards, REST APIs

Experiência prévia com o módulo APM é desejável

Outras habilidades e competências

Capacidade de adaptação rápida para aprender novas ferramentas, novas tecnologias e padrões atuais do mercado

Capacidade de trabalhar em ambiente global e distribuído, sem supervisão

Perfil autodirigido, proativo e com pensamento sistêmico

title: Opentext Consultant
description:
OpenText VIM/OCR Expert - Remote working - English Speaking

title: Ai-Augmented Software Engineer
description:
AI-Augmented Software Engineer

Python | JavaScript | Cloud | AI Coding Agents

We are looking for a Software Engineer who builds software with AI as a core part of the development workflow.

This role is not for engineers who occasionally use Copilot. We are looking for developers who already work in an AI-augmented engineering environment, using tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or other AI coding agents to significantly accelerate development.

You should be comfortable allowing AI to generate large portions of code, while maintaining full responsibility for architecture, quality, and system reliability.

What You'll Build

You will help design and develop modern backend systems and scalable APIs that power high-growth products.

Typical responsibilities include:

  • Designing scalable backend services
  • Building APIs using Python and JavaScript/TypeScript
  • Using AI coding agents to implement and refactor features
  • Reviewing AI-generated code for quality, security, and correctness
  • Automating CI/CD pipelines and deployments
  • Running and maintaining services in cloud environments
  • Improving system reliability, observability, and performance

Required Technical Skills

Strong experience with:

  • Python (FastAPI, Django, Flask, or similar)
  • JavaScript or TypeScript (Node.Js ecosystem)
  • Designing and building REST APIs
  • Git workflows and code reviews
  • Automated testing
  • Cloud environments (AWS, GCP, or Azure)
  • Docker and containerized applications

AI-Augmented Engineering

You must already use AI tools as part of your daily development workflow.

Examples include:

  • Claude Code
  • Cursor IDE
  • GitHub Copilot
  • OpenAI Codex
  • Gemini Code Assist
  • Other AI coding agents

Expected capabilities:

  • Writing structured prompts for code generation
  • Using AI to implement features across multiple files
  • Generating and improving automated tests
  • Refactoring existing codebases with AI assistance
  • Debugging systems with AI tools

DevOps Experience (Preferred)

Experience with some of the following:

  • Docker
  • Kubernetes
  • CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, CircleCI)
  • Infrastructure as Code (Terraform or similar)
  • Monitoring and observability tools

Nice to Have

  • Experience building AI-powered applications
  • Experience working with LLM APIs
  • Experience with distributed systems
  • Experience in startup or fast-paced product environments
  • Open source contributions

Our Engineering Philosophy

We believe the future of software engineering is AI-augmented.

Great engineers today:

  • design systems
  • orchestrate AI tools
  • move fast without sacrificing quality

If this sounds like how you already work, we would love to talk.
